sanskrit_iast: ataḥ paraṃ pariśiṣṭā maitrāyaṇīyasūtrasya | gṛhyapuruṣaḥ prāyaścittam anugrahikahautṛkaśulvikottareṣṭakavaiṣṇavādhvaryavikacāturhotṛkagonāmikākulapādarahasyapratigrahayamakavṛṣotsargapraśnadraviṇaṣaṭkāraṇapradhānasāṃdehikapravarādhyāyarudravidhānachando'nukramaṇyantarkyakalpapravāsavidhiprātarupasthānabhūtotpattir iti dvāviṃśatiḥ pariśiṣṭasaṃkhyānām |
meaning: अतः परं परिशिष्टा मैत्रायणीयसूत्रस्य । गृह्यपुरुषः प्रायश्चित्तम् अनुग्रहिकहौतृकशुल्विकोत्तरेष्टकवैष्णवाध्वर्यविकचातुर्होतृकगोनामिकाकुलपादरहस्यप्रतिग्रहयमकवृषोत्सर्गप्रश्नद्रविणषट्कारणप्रधानसांदेहिकप्रवराध्यायरुद्रविधानछन्दोऽनुक्रमण्यन्तर्क्यकल्पप्रवासविधिप्रातरुपस्थानभूतोत्पत्तिर् इति द्वाविंशतिः परिशिष्टसंख्यानाम् ।
text_mt:
Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 1.
Now follow the supplementary texts (pariśiṣṭa) to the Maitrāyaṇīya sūtra:
Gṛhyapuruṣa, Prāyaścitta, Anugrahika, Hautṛka, Śulvika, Uttareṣṭaka, Vaiṣṇava, Ādhvaryavika, Cāturhotṛka, Gonāmika, Kulapāda, Rahasya, Pratigraha, Yamaka, Vṛṣotsarga, Praśna, Draviṇa, Ṣaṭkāraṇa, Pradhāna, Sāṃdehika, Pravarādhyāya, Rudravidhāna, Chando'nukramaṇī, Antarkyakalpa, Pravāsavidhi, Prātarupasthāna, and Bhūtotpatti—these make up twenty-two in the count of supplements.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhye 'gnau pākayajñān viharet |
meaning: गृह्ये ऽग्नौ पाकयज्ञान् विहरेत् ।
text_mt: One should perform the simple sacrifices in the domestic fire.

sanskrit_iast: hrasvatvāt pākayajñaḥ | hrasvaṃ hi pāka ityācakṣate |
meaning: ह्रस्वत्वात् पाकयज्ञः । ह्रस्वं हि पाक इत्याचक्षते ।
text_mt: It is called a simple sacrifice (pākayajña) because of shortness; for they designate that which is short as 'pāka'.

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtiḥ pākayajñavidhir aprayājo 'nanuyājo 'sāmidhenīkaḥ |
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासप्रकृतिः पाकयज्ञविधिर् अप्रयाजो ऽननुयाजो ऽसामिधेनीकः ।
text_mt: The paradigm for the simple sacrifice is the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, without fore-offerings, without after-offerings, and without kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: svāhākārāntaṃ nigadya homāḥ |
meaning: स्वाहाकारान्तं निगद्य होमाः ।
text_mt: The fire offerings are made reciting [the formula] ending with the call of svāhā.

sanskrit_iast: paratantrotpattir dakṣiṇāgnāv āhitāgniḥ kurvīta śālāgnāv anāhitāgniḥ |
meaning: परतन्त्रोत्पत्तिर् दक्षिणाग्नाव् आहिताग्निः कुर्वीत शालाग्नाव् अनाहिताग्निः ।
text_mt: The maintainer of sacred fires should perform an independent rite in the southern fire; one who has not set up the sacred fires, in the hall fire.

sanskrit_iast: gomayena gocarmamātraṃ caturasraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipyeṣumātraṃ tasmin lakṣaṇaṃ kurvīta satyasadasīti paścārdhād udīcīṃ lekhāṃ likhati | ṛtasadasīti dakṣiṇārdhāt prācīm | gharmasadasīty uttarārdhāt prācīm | madhye dve tisro vā prācīḥ | ūrjasvatīti dakṣiṇām | payasvatīty uttarām | indrāya tveti madhyād vā | sarvāḥ prādeśamātryo darbheṇāvalikhet |
meaning: गोमयेन गोचर्ममात्रं चतुरस्रं स्थण्डिलम् उपलिप्येषुमात्रं तस्मिन् लक्षणं कुर्वीत सत्यसदसीति पश्चार्धाद् उदीचीं लेखां लिखति । ऋतसदसीति दक्षिणार्धात् प्राचीम् । घर्मसदसीत्य् उत्तरार्धात् प्राचीम् । मध्ये द्वे तिस्रो वा प्राचीः । ऊर्जस्वतीति दक्षिणाम् । पयस्वतीत्य् उत्तराम् । इन्द्राय त्वेति मध्याद् वा । सर्वाः प्रादेशमात्र्यो दर्भेणावलिखेत् ।
text_mt: Having smeared with cow dung a square sacrificial mound measuring a cow-hide, he should make lines measuring an arrow upon it: from the western half he draws a line pointing northward with [the formula], 'You are the seat of truth'; pointing eastward from the southern half with, 'You are the seat of cosmic order'; pointing eastward from the northern half with, 'You are the seat of heat'; in the middle [he draws] two or three pointing eastward: the southern one with, 'You are rich in sap'; the northern one with, 'You are rich in milk'; or from the middle with, 'To Indra, thee!' He should draw all of them, measuring a span, with a blade of darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast: adbhiḥ prokṣyāgniṃ sādayati |
meaning: अद्भिः प्रोक्ष्याग्निं सादयति ।
text_mt: Having sprinkled it with water, he places the fire [upon it].

sanskrit_iast: parisamuhya paristīrya paryukṣya tūṣṇīm idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya grāgagrair dakṣiṇārambhair udaksaṃsthairayugmair dhātubhiḥ stṛṇāti |
meaning: परिसमुह्य परिस्तीर्य पर्युक्ष्य तूष्णीम् इध्माबर्हिः संनह्य ग्रागग्रैर् दक्षिणारम्भैर् उदक्संस्थैरयुग्मैर् धातुभिः स्तृणाति ।
text_mt: Having swept around it, strewn [grass] around it, and sprinkled it with water, having silently bound the firewood bundle and sacrificial grass, he strews [grass] with tips pointing east, beginning from the south, ending in the north, in uneven layers.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato 'gner brahmāṇam upaveśyottarata udapātram |
meaning: दक्षिणतो ऽग्नेर् ब्रह्माणम् उपवेश्योत्तरत उदपात्रम् ।
text_mt: Having seated the Brahman priest to the south of the fire, [he places] a water vessel to the north.

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣaḥ pavitre kurute |
meaning: बर्हिषः पवित्रे कुरुते ।
text_mt: He prepares two purifying strainers from the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: samāv apracchinnaprāntau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre stho vaiṣṇavye ityoṣadhyā chittvā viṣṇormanasā pūte stha ity adbhis trir unmṛjya prokṣaṇīr dharmaiḥ saṃskṛtya praṇītāṃ praṇīya nirvapaṇaprokṣaṇasaṃvapanam iti yathādevataṃ carum adhiśritya sruksruvaṃ pramṛjyābhyukṣyāgnau pratāpyāditir asi nācchinnapattrety ājyam agnāv adhiśrayati |
meaning: समाव् अप्रच्छिन्नप्रान्तौ दर्भौ प्रादेशमात्रौ पवित्रे स्थो वैष्णव्ये इत्योषध्या छित्त्वा विष्णोर्मनसा पूते स्थ इत्य् अद्भिस् त्रिर् उन्मृज्य प्रोक्षणीर् धर्मैः संस्कृत्य प्रणीतां प्रणीय निर्वपणप्रोक्षणसंवपनम् इति यथादेवतं चरुम् अधिश्रित्य स्रुक्स्रुवं प्रमृज्याभ्युक्ष्याग्नौ प्रताप्यादितिर् असि नाच्छिन्नपत्त्रेत्य् आज्यम् अग्नाव् अधिश्रयति ।
text_mt: Having cut off two equal blades of darbha grass without split tips, measuring a span, with a plant, saying, 'You two are the purifying strainers sacred to Viṣṇu,' having wiped them upward three times with water, saying, 'You two are purified by the mind of Viṣṇu,' having prepared the sprinkling water according to the prescribed rules, having brought forward the holy water, [and performed] the measuring out, sprinkling, and putting together, having placed the sacrificial porridge over the fire according to the deity, having wiped the large offering ladle and the small dipping ladle, sprinkled them with water, and heated them in the fire, he places the clarified butter over the fire with, 'You are Aditi, whose leaves are unbroken.'

sanskrit_iast: pṛśneḥ payo 'sīty ājyaṃ nirvapati |
meaning: पृश्नेः पयो ऽसीत्य् आज्यं निर्वपति ।
text_mt: He ladles out the clarified butter with, 'You are the milk of Pṛśni.'

sanskrit_iast: pari vājapatir ityājyahaviś ca triḥ paryagnikaroti |
meaning: परि वाजपतिर् इत्याज्यहविश् च त्रिः पर्यग्निकरोति ।
text_mt: With [the formula], 'Round about the lord of wealth…,' he carries the fire thrice around the clarified butter and the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: devas tvā savitotpunātv ityājyaṃ śrapayati |
meaning: देवस् त्वा सवितोत्पुनात्व् इत्याज्यं श्रपयति ।
text_mt: With [the formula], 'May god Savitṛ purify thee…,' he cooks the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm idhmābarhir viprokṣya yathā mnātam abhiparistṛṇāti |
meaning: तूष्णीम् इध्माबर्हिर् विप्रोक्ष्य यथा म्नातम् अभिपरिस्तृणाति ।
text_mt: Silently sprinkling the firewood bundle and sacrificial grass, he strews [grass] all around according to the traditional rule.

sanskrit_iast: paridhīn paridadhāti |
meaning: परिधीन् परिदधाति ।

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'sītyājyamavekṣya paścādagnerdarbheṣvāsādayati |
meaning: तेजो ऽसीत्याज्यमवेक्ष्य पश्चादग्नेर्दर्भेष्वासादयति ।
text_mt: Looking at the clarified butter with [the formula], 'You are brilliance,' he places it on the darbha grass to the west of the fire.

sanskrit_iast: abhighārya sthālīpākamuttarata udvāsayati |
meaning: अभिघार्य स्थालीपाकमुत्तरत उद्वासयति ।
text_mt: Having basted the pot-cooked offering, he takes it down to the north.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛdevedhmamādhāya vairūpākṣaḥ prathamo homānām |
meaning: सकृदेवेध्ममाधाय वैरूपाक्षः प्रथमो होमानाम् ।
text_mt: Having put on the firewood bundle once, the Vairūpākṣa [formula] is the first of the fire offerings.

sanskrit_iast: brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā yunajmi tveti ca yojayitvā |
meaning: ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य समिधम् आधायाघाराव् आघार्याज्यभागौ हुत्वा युनज्मि त्वेति च योजयित्वा ।
text_mt: Having addressed the Brahman priest, having placed a kindling stick, having poured the two libations of clarified butter, having offered the two portions of clarified butter, and having harnessed [the fire] with, 'I yoke thee…,'

sanskrit_iast: nahy ayukto havyaṃ vahata iti ha vijñāyate |
meaning: नह्य् अयुक्तो हव्यं वहत इति ह विज्ञायते ।
text_mt: for it is known: 'When unharnessed, he does not carry the offering.'

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ purastāddhuro juhoti | yukto vaha jātavedaḥ purastādidaṃ viddhi kriyamāṇaṃ yatheha | tvaṃ bhiṣagbheṣajasyāsi goptā tvayā prasūtā gāmaśvaṃ pūruṣaṃ sanema | svāhā | iti |
meaning: कामं पुरस्ताद्धुरो जुहोति । युक्तो वह जातवेदः पुरस्तादिदं विद्धि क्रियमाणं यथेह । त्वं भिषग्भेषजस्यासि गोप्ता त्वया प्रसूता गामश्वं पूरुषं सनेम । स्वाहा । इति ।
text_mt: At will he offers in front of the yoke: / 'Yoked, carry [the oblation], O Jātavedas, in front; know this as it is being performed here; / you are the physician, the guardian of the medicine; impelled by you, may we gain cattle, horses, and men. / Svāhā!' / thus.

sanskrit_iast: viśvā agne tvayā vayaṃ dhārā udanyā iva | atigāhemahi dviṣam |
meaning: विश्वा अग्ने त्वया वयं धारा उदन्या इव । अतिगाहेमहि द्विषम् ।
text_mt: 'May we, O Agni, through you, cross over the enemy, / as over all waters through a downpour.'

sanskrit_iast: iti | nakṣatramiṣṭvā devatāṃ yajeta | ahorātramṛtuṃ tithiṃ ca |
meaning: इति । नक्षत्रमिष्ट्वा देवतां यजेत । अहोरात्रमृतुं तिथिं च ।
text_mt: Thus. / Having sacrificed to the lunar mansion, he should sacrifice to the deity, / and to the day and night, the season, and the lunar day.

sanskrit_iast: abhighārya yaddevataṃ haviḥ syāttac ca juhuyād yathādevataṃ yathādevatayā carcā |
meaning: अभिघार्य यद्देवतं हविः स्यात्तच् च जुहुयाद् यथादेवतं यथादेवतया चर्चा ।
text_mt: Having basted [it], whatever deity the oblation belongs to, he should offer that according to the deity, with the verse belonging to that deity.

sanskrit_iast: ākūtāya svāhā | ākūtaye svāheti jayān juhuyāt |
meaning: आकूताय स्वाहा । आकूतये स्वाहेति जयान् जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: He should offer the Jaya offerings with, 'To design, svāhā! To intention, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prāyacchat | iḍām agna iti sviṣṭakṛtam uttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhuyāt |
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रायच्छत् । इडाम् अग्न इति स्विष्टकृतम् उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: He should offer [the oblation] to Sviṣṭakṛt in the north-eastern part [of the fire] with, 'Prajāpati gave…,' [and] 'O Agni, the refreshment…'

sanskrit_iast: mekṣaṇam upayāmaṃ pavitre cānvādadhyāt |
meaning: मेक्षणम् उपयामं पवित्रे चान्वादध्यात् ।
text_mt: He should put on the fire the stirring stick, the support stick, and the two purifying strainers.

sanskrit_iast: anv adya no 'numatiḥ | anv id anumate tvam iti | bhūḥ svāheti prāyaścittāhutīśca |
meaning: अन्व् अद्य नो ऽनुमतिः । अन्व् इद् अनुमते त्वम् इति । भूः स्वाहेति प्रायश्चित्ताहुतीश्च ।
text_mt: And [he offers] the expiation oblations with, 'May Anumati today…,' 'Do you, O Anumati…,' and 'Bhūḥ svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: tvan no 'gne | sa tvan no 'gne | mano jyotiḥ | trayastriṃśattantavaḥ | ayāścāgne 'sīti ca |
meaning: त्वन् नो ऽग्ने । स त्वन् नो ऽग्ने । मनो ज्योतिः । त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तन्तवः । अयाश्चाग्ने ऽसीति च ।
text_mt: And with: 'Do you, O Agni…,' 'So, you, O Agni…,' 'The mind is light…,' 'Thirty-three threads…,' and 'You are uninjurable, O Agni…'

sanskrit_iast: imaṃ stanaṃ madhumantaṃ dhayāpāṃ prapīnamagne salilasya madhye | utsaṃ juṣasva madhumantam ūrmiṃ samudryaṃ sadanam āviśasva | svāhā | iti paridhivimokam abhijuhoti |
meaning: इमं स्तनं मधुमन्तं धयापां प्रपीनमग्ने सलिलस्य मध्ये । उत्सं जुषस्व मधुमन्तम् ऊर्मिं समुद्र्यं सदनम् आविशस्व । स्वाहा । इति परिधिविमोकम् अभिजुहोति ।
text_mt: 'Suck this honeyed breast of the waters, swollen in the midst of the water, O Agni; / enjoy the honeyed spring, the wave; enter your ocean dwelling. / Svāhā!' / With this he offers the release of the enclosing sticks.

sanskrit_iast: annapata ityannasya juhuyāt |
meaning: अन्नपत इत्यन्नस्य जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: With, 'O lord of food…,' he should offer of the food.

sanskrit_iast: edho 'syedhīṣīmahi svāheti samidham ādadhāti | samidasi samedhiṣīmahīti dvitīyām |
meaning: एधो ऽस्येधीषीमहि स्वाहेति समिधम् आदधाति । समिदसि समेधिषीमहीति द्वितीयाम् ।
text_mt: He puts on a kindling stick with, 'You are kindling; may we prosper, svāhā!'; a second with, 'You are a kindling stick; may we thrive!'

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣi pūrṇapātraṃ ninayet |
meaning: बर्हिषि पूर्णपात्रं निनयेत् ।
text_mt: He should pour out the full cup upon the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: eṣo 'vabhṛthaḥ |
meaning: एषो ऽवभृथः ।

sanskrit_iast: pākayajñānām etattantram |
meaning: पाकयज्ञानाम् एतत्तन्त्रम् ।
text_mt: This is the general procedure for simple sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: āpohiṣṭhīyābhir mārjayitvā paryukṣeta |
meaning: आपोहिष्ठीयाभिर् मार्जयित्वा पर्युक्षेत ।
text_mt: Having wiped himself with the verses beginning with 'Āpo hi ṣṭhā…,' he should sprinkle water around [the fire].

sanskrit_iast: varo dakṣiṇā | aśvaṃ varaṃ vidyāt | gāmityeke |
meaning: वरो दक्षिणा । अश्वं वरं विद्यात् । गामित्येके ।
text_mt:
A choice gift is the sacrificial gift; / one should know the choice gift to be a horse; / a cow, say some.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 2.
Having prepared the confinement chamber facing east or north, he should make her enter it at the [proper] time with, 'I take refuge in the firm; I take refuge in the auspicious; I take refuge in the quarter.'

sanskrit_iast: prāṅmukham udaṅmukhaṃ vā sūtikālayaṃ kalpayitvā dhruvaṃ prapadye śubhaṃ prapadya āśāṃ prapadya iti kāle prapādayet |
meaning: प्राङ्मुखम् उदङ्मुखं वा सूतिकालयं कल्पयित्वा ध्रुवं प्रपद्ये शुभं प्रपद्य आशां प्रपद्य इति काले प्रपादयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: reto mūtramiti cyāvanībhyāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣim abhimṛśet | śrāvayedvā |
meaning: रेतो मूत्रमिति च्यावनीभ्यां दक्षिणं कुक्षिम् अभिमृशेत् । श्रावयेद्वा ।
text_mt: With the two deliverance verses beginning with 'Semen, urine…,' he should touch her right flank, or recite them [aloud].

sanskrit_iast: putraṃ jātam anvakṣaṃ snātaṃ na mātopahanyād ā mantraprayogāt |
meaning: पुत्रं जातम् अन्वक्षं स्नातं न मातोपहन्याद् आ मन्त्रप्रयोगात् ।
text_mt: The mother should not touch the son who has been born and immediately bathed, until the ritual recitation of the mantras.

sanskrit_iast: agner abhyāhitasya parisamūḍhasya paristīrṇasya paścād ahate vāsasi kumāraṃ prākśirasam uttānaṃ saṃveśya palāśasya madhyamaṃ parṇaṃ praveṣṭya tenāsya karṇāv ājapet bhūs tvayi dadhānīti dakṣiṇe | bhuvas tvayi dadhānīti savye | svas tvayi dadhānīti dakṣiṇe | bhūr bhuvaḥ svas tvayi dadhānīti savye |
meaning: अग्नेर् अभ्याहितस्य परिसमूढस्य परिस्तीर्णस्य पश्चाद् अहते वाससि कुमारं प्राक्शिरसम् उत्तानं संवेश्य पलाशस्य मध्यमं पर्णं प्रवेष्ट्य तेनास्य कर्णाव् आजपेत् भूस् त्वयि दधानीति दक्षिणे । भुवस् त्वयि दधानीति सव्ये । स्वस् त्वयि दधानीति दक्षिणे । भूर् भुवः स्वस् त्वयि दधानीति सव्ये ।
text_mt: To the west of the fire which has been heaped up, swept around, and strewn around with grass, having laid the boy down on an unwashed garment, facing east with his face turned upward, having rolled up the middle leaf of a palāśa, he should whisper into his ears through it: 'I place bhūḥ in you' into the right; / 'I place bhuvaḥ in you' into the left; / 'I place svaḥ in you' into the right; / 'I place bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ in you' into the left.

sanskrit_iast: athainam abhimantrayete | aśmā bhava paraśur bhava hiraṇyam astṛtaṃ bhava | aṅgād aṅgāt sambhavasi hṛdayād adhijāyase | ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam | iti |
meaning: अथैनम् अभिमन्त्रयेते । अश्मा भव परशुर् भव हिरण्यम् अस्तृतं भव । अङ्गाद् अङ्गात् सम्भवसि हृदयाद् अधिजायसे । आत्मा वै पुत्रनामासि स जीव शरदः शतम् । इति ।
text_mt: Then both address him with mantras: / 'Be a stone, be an axe, be imperishable gold! / From limb by limb you are produced, from the heart you are born; / you are the self named "son"; so live a hundred autumns!' / thus.

sanskrit_iast: yatra śete tadabhimṛśet veda te bhūmi hṛdayaṃ divi candramasi śritam | vedāmṛtasya devā māhaṃ putryam aghaṃ rudam | iti |
meaning: यत्र शेते तदभिमृशेत् वेद ते भूमि हृदयं दिवि चन्द्रमसि श्रितम् । वेदामृतस्य देवा माहं पुत्र्यम् अघं रुदम् । इति ।
text_mt: He should touch the place where he lies: / 'I know your heart, O earth, resting in the moon in heaven; / may the gods know me as of the immortal; may I not weep for evil befalling a child!' / thus.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā vyāhṛtibhiś catasra ājyāhutīr juhuyāt | jayābhyātānānāṃ rāṣṭrabhṛtaś caike |
meaning: आज्यं संस्कृत्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य समिधम् आधायाघाराव् आघार्याज्यभागौ हुत्वा व्याहृतिभिश् चतस्र आज्याहुतीर् जुहुयात् । जयाभ्यातानानां राष्ट्रभृतश् चैके ।
text_mt: Having prepared the clarified butter, having addressed the Brahman priest, having put on a kindling stick, having poured the two libations of clarified butter, and having offered the two portions of clarified butter, he should offer four oblations of clarified butter with the mystic utterances; and according to some, [oblations] of the Jaya, Abhyātāna, and realm-sustaining formulas.

sanskrit_iast: kāṃsye camase vāhūtisampātān avanīya tasmin suvarṇaṃ saṃnighṛṣya vyāhṛtibhiḥ kumāraṃ catuḥ prāśayet | atyantam eke suvarṇaprāśanam udake nighṛṣyā dvādaśavarṣatāyāḥ |
meaning: कांस्ये चमसे वाहूतिसम्पातान् अवनीय तस्मिन् सुवर्णं संनिघृष्य व्याहृतिभिः कुमारं चतुः प्राशयेत् । अत्यन्तम् एके सुवर्णप्राशनम् उदके निघृष्या द्वादशवर्षतायाः ।
text_mt: Having poured the residues of the oblations into a bronze or wooden cup, and having rubbed gold in it, he should feed it to the boy four times with the mystic utterances; some [prescribe] continuous feeding of gold, rubbed in water, up to the completion of twelve years.

sanskrit_iast: iṣaṃ pinva | ūrjaṃ pinveti stanau prakṣālya pradhāpayet | dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvaṃ savyaṃ paścāt |
meaning: इषं पिन्व । ऊर्जं पिन्वेति स्तनौ प्रक्षाल्य प्रधापयेत् । दक्षिणं पूर्वं सव्यं पश्चात् ।
text_mt: With 'Swell with nourishment,' / and 'Swell with vigor,' having washed her breasts, he should cause [the mother] to nurse him, / the right one first, the left one afterward.

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭakṛte hutvā prāyaścittāhutīśca samidhamādhāya paryukṣati |
meaning: स्विष्टकृते हुत्वा प्रायश्चित्ताहुतीश्च समिधमाधाय पर्युक्षति ।
text_mt: Having offered to Sviṣṭakṛt and [having made] the expiation offerings, having added a kindling stick, he sprinkles [water] around.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa karmānto bahirdvāre 'gnir nityaḥ | kaṇasarṣapayavānāṃ homaḥ | vyāhṛtibhir juhuyāt |
meaning: एष कर्मान्तो बहिर्द्वारे ऽग्निर् नित्यः । कणसर्षपयवानां होमः । व्याहृतिभिर् जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: This is the conclusion of the ritual. The fire outside the door is perpetual. / There is an offering of groats, mustard seeds, and barley. / He should offer with the mystic utterances.

sanskrit_iast: apratirathaṃ japet | indro bhūtasyeti ṣaḍarcaṃ ca |
meaning: अप्रतिरथं जपेत् । इन्द्रो भूतस्येति षडर्चं च ।
text_mt: He should murmur the Apratiratha hymn, / and the six verses beginning with 'Indra of that which is.'

sanskrit_iast: sūtikālayaṃ yathākālaṃ samantād udakena pariṣiñcet |
meaning: सूतिकालयं यथाकालं समन्ताद् उदकेन परिषिञ्चेत् ।
text_mt:
At the proper time, he should sprinkle the confinement chamber all around with water.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 3
Having performed [the rite] in this very way on the tenth day, the father and the mother should give a name to the son: having a voiced consonant at the beginning, a semivowel in the middle, ending in a long vowel or a visarga, formed with a primary suffix and not a secondary suffix, consisting of two syllables or four syllables; or, abandoning [the derivation] from the father's name, having the names of constellations, deities, or desired ones.

sanskrit_iast: evam eva daśamyāṃ kṛtvā pitā mātā ca putrasya nāma dadhyatām ghoṣavadādyantarantasthaṃ dīrghābhiniṣṭānāntaṃ kṛtaṃ na taddhitaṃ dvyakṣaraṃ caturakṣaraṃ vā tyaktvā pitur nāmadheyāt nakṣatradevateṣṭanāmāno vā |
meaning: एवम् एव दशम्यां कृत्वा पिता माता च पुत्रस्य नाम दध्यताम् घोषवदाद्यन्तरन्तस्थं दीर्घाभिनिष्टानान्तं कृतं न तद्धितं द्व्यक्षरं चतुरक्षरं वा त्यक्त्वा पितुर् नामधेयात् नक्षत्रदेवतेष्टनामानो वा ।

sanskrit_iast: dvināmā tu brāhmaṇaḥ |
meaning: द्विनामा तु ब्राह्मणः ।

sanskrit_iast: nāmaiva kanyāyāḥ akāravyavadhānam ākārāntam ayugmākṣaraṃ nadīnakṣatracandrasūryapūṣadevadattarakṣitāvarjam |
meaning: नामैव कन्यायाः अकारव्यवधानम् आकारान्तम् अयुग्माक्षरं नदीनक्षत्रचन्द्रसूर्यपूषदेवदत्तरक्षितावर्जम् ।
text_mt: The name of a girl is just [a single name], having the vowel a as an intervention, ending in a long ā, having an uneven number of syllables, avoiding [names of] rivers, constellations, the moon, the sun, Pūṣan, Devadatta, and Rakṣita.

sanskrit_iast: navanītena pāṇī pralipya somasya tvā dyumnenety enamabhimṛśet |
meaning: नवनीतेन पाणी प्रलिप्य सोमस्य त्वा द्युम्नेनेत्य् एनमभिमृशेत् ।
text_mt: Having smeared both hands with fresh butter, he should touch him with 'With the glory of Soma thee...'.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣu kumārakarmasv āgneyaḥ sthālīpākaḥ prājāpatyo vā |
meaning: सर्वेषु कुमारकर्मस्व् आग्नेयः स्थालीपाकः प्राजापत्यो वा ।
text_mt: In all rites for a child, the pot-cooked offering is dedicated to Agni or dedicated to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatrānādeśe 'gniḥ puṃsām aryamā strīṇām |
meaning: सर्वत्रानादेशे ऽग्निः पुंसाम् अर्यमा स्त्रीणाम् ।
text_mt: Everywhere, when unspecified, [the deity] is Agni for males, Aryaman for females.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ mātāpitarau na māṃsam aśnīyātām |
meaning: संवत्सरं मातापितरौ न मांसम् अश्नीयाताम् ।
text_mt: For a year, the mother and father should not eat meat.

sanskrit_iast: putrasya jātadante yajetāgniṃ gavā paśunā vā |
meaning: पुत्रस्य जातदन्ते यजेताग्निं गवा पशुना वा ।
text_mt: When the son has teethed, he should sacrifice to Agni with a cow or with an animal.

sanskrit_iast: viproṣitaḥ pratyetya putrasya mūrdhānaṃ trir ājighret paśūnāṃ tvā hiṃkāreṇābhijighrāmīti |
meaning: विप्रोषितः प्रत्येत्य पुत्रस्य मूर्धानं त्रिर् आजिघ्रेत् पशूनां त्वा हिंकारेणाभिजिघ्रामीति ।
text_mt: Returning from a journey, he should smell the head of his son three times with 'With the lowing of cattle I smell thee.'

sanskrit_iast: jātakarmavaddhastāṅguliṃ praveṣṭya tenāsya karṇāv ājapet |
meaning: जातकर्मवद्धस्ताङ्गुलिं प्रवेष्ट्य तेनास्य कर्णाव् आजपेत् ।
text_mt: Wrapping his finger around [the cloth] as in the birth-rite, with that he should murmur into his ears.

sanskrit_iast: athainamabhimantrayate aśmā bhaveti |
meaning: अथैनमभिमन्त्रयते अश्मा भवेति ।
text_mt: Then he addresses him with 'Be a stone.'

sanskrit_iast: agnidhanvantarī putravratī chāgameṣābhyām iṣṭvā dīrghāṇāṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ kumāraṃ catuḥ prāśayet | āyurdā deveti ca |
meaning: अग्निधन्वन्तरी पुत्रव्रती छागमेषाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा दीर्घाणां व्याहृतिभिः कुमारं चतुः प्राशयेत् । आयुर्दा देवेति च ।
text_mt: One who has undertaken the vow for a son, having sacrificed to Agni and Dhanvantari with a goat and a ram, should make the child eat four times with the long mystic utterances / and with 'O god, giver of life.'

sanskrit_iast: kumārakarmāṇi śukla udagayane puṇye nakṣatre navamīvarjam | sarva ṛtavo vivāhe 'māghacaitrau māsau parihāpyottaraṃ ca naidāgham |
meaning: कुमारकर्माणि शुक्ल उदगयने पुण्ये नक्षत्रे नवमीवर्जम् । सर्व ऋतवो विवाहे ऽमाघचैत्रौ मासौ परिहाप्योत्तरं च नैदाघम् ।
text_mt: The rites for a child [are performed] in the bright [fortnight], in the northern course of the sun, under an auspicious constellation, excluding the ninth [tithi]; / all seasons are suitable for a marriage, leaving out the months of Māgha and Caitra, and the subsequent summer month.

sanskrit_iast: anvārambhayitvā havanam |
meaning: अन्वारम्भयित्वा हवनम् ।
text_mt:
Having caused him to hold on from behind, the offering [is made].

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 4
In the third year they make the tufts [of hair], / or according to the custom of the family.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyavarṣasya jaṭāḥ kurvanti | yathā vā kulakalpaḥ |
meaning: तृतीयवर्षस्य जटाः कुर्वन्ति । यथा वा कुलकल्पः ।

sanskrit_iast: agnim upasamādhāya parisamuhya paristīrya paryukṣya dakṣiṇato 'gner brahmāṇam upaveśyottarata udapātraṃ śamīśamakavat |
meaning: अग्निम् उपसमाधाय परिसमुह्य परिस्तीर्य पर्युक्ष्य दक्षिणतो ऽग्नेर् ब्रह्माणम् उपवेश्योत्तरत उदपात्रं शमीशमकवत् ।
text_mt: Having set up the fire, swept around it, strewn [sacrificial grass] around it, sprinkled [water] around it, seated the Brahman priest to the south of the fire, [he places] a water-vessel containing leaves of the śamī tree to the north.

sanskrit_iast: athainam abhimantrayate hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucaya iti catasṛbhiḥ | yā oṣadhaya ityanuvākena | śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye | śaṃ yor abhisravantu naḥ | priyāḥ śaṃ na āpo dhanvanyāḥ śaṃ naḥ santu nūpyāḥ | śaṃ naḥ samudryā āpaḥ śam u naḥ santu kūpyāḥ | śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatv aryamā | śaṃ na indraś cāgniś ca śaṃ no viṣṇur urukramaḥ | iti | tāsām udakārthān kurvīta paryukṣaṇe 'bhyundane snāpane ca |
meaning: अथैनम् अभिमन्त्रयते हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचय इति चतसृभिः । या ओषधय इत्यनुवाकेन । शं नो देवीर् अभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये । शं योर् अभिस्रवन्तु नः । प्रियाः शं न आपो धन्वन्याः शं नः सन्तु नूप्याः । शं नः समुद्र्या आपः शम् उ नः सन्तु कूप्याः । शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं नो भवत्व् अर्यमा । शं न इन्द्रश् चाग्निश् च शं नो विष्णुर् उरुक्रमः । इति । तासाम् उदकार्थान् कुर्वीत पर्युक्षणे ऽभ्युन्दने स्नापने च ।
text_mt:
Then he addresses him with the four verses 'Golden-colored, pure...'; / with the recitation section 'Which herbs...'; / with
'May the divine waters be for our aid, for drinking; / may they stream forth to us for welfare and health.'
'May the waters of the desert be dear and auspicious to us; may those of the marsh be auspicious to us; / may the waters of the sea be auspicious to us, and may those of the well be auspicious to us.'
'May Mitra be auspicious to us, may Varuṇa be auspicious; may Aryaman be auspicious to us; / may Indra and Agni be auspicious to us; may Viṣṇu of wide strides be auspicious to us.'
Thus. / With those [waters] he should perform the actions requiring water: at the sprinkling around, at the moistening, and at the bathing.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā agnā āyūṃṣi pavasa iti saptabhiḥ sapta hutvā |
meaning: आज्यं संस्कृत्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य समिधम् आधायाघाराव् आघार्याज्यभागौ हुत्वा अग्ना आयूंषि पवस इति सप्तभिः सप्त हुत्वा ।
text_mt: Having prepared the clarified butter, called upon the Brahman priest, placed the kindling stick, poured out the two libations of clarified butter, offered the two portions of clarified butter, having offered seven [oblations] with the seven verses beginning with 'O Agni, thou purifiest life,'

sanskrit_iast: āyurdā deveti ca | ye keśinaḥ prathame sattram āsata yebhir āvṛtaṃ yadidaṃ virājati | tebhyo juhomy āyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya svastaye | iti |
meaning: आयुर्दा देवेति च । ये केशिनः प्रथमे सत्त्रम् आसत येभिर् आवृतं यदिदं विराजति । तेभ्यो जुहोम्य् आयुषे दीर्घायुत्वाय स्वस्तये । इति ।
text_mt:
and with 'O god, giver of life,' / and
'The hairy ones who first sat at the sacrificial session, by whom this [universe] is encompassed which shines forth: / to them I offer for life, for longevity, for welfare,' / thus;

sanskrit_iast: vyāhṛtibhiśca |
meaning: व्याहृतिभिश्च ।

sanskrit_iast: uktaḥ karmāntaḥ pūrveṇa |
meaning: उक्तः कर्मान्तः पूर्वेण ।
text_mt: The conclusion of the ritual has been stated before.

sanskrit_iast: śītena vāya udakenedhi | uṣṇena vāya udakenedhīti taptā itarābhiḥ saṃsṛjya ārdradānava stha jīvadān avasthondatīriṣamāvadety apo 'bhimantrya dakṣiṇaṃ keśāntam abhyundyāt | aditiḥ keśān vapatvāpa undantu jīvase | dīrghāyutvāya svastaye | iti |
meaning: शीतेन वाय उदकेनेधि । उष्णेन वाय उदकेनेधीति तप्ता इतराभिः संसृज्य आर्द्रदानव स्थ जीवदान् अवस्थोन्दतीरिषमावदेत्य् अपो ऽभिमन्त्र्य दक्षिणं केशान्तम् अभ्युन्द्यात् । अदितिः केशान् वपत्वाप उन्दन्तु जीवसे । दीर्घायुत्वाय स्वस्तये । इति ।
text_mt:
Saying 'Kindle [it] with cold water, O Vāyu,' / and 'Kindle [it] with hot water, O Vāyu,' having mixed the heated [water] with the other, having addressed the water with 'You are moist-givers, life-givers; moistening [waters], bring food,' he should moisten the right hair-boundary with:
'May Aditi shave the hair; may the waters moisten for living, / for longevity, for welfare,' / thus.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasmin keśānte darbham ūrdhvāgraṃ nidadhāti |
meaning: दक्षिणस्मिन् केशान्ते दर्भम् ऊर्ध्वाग्रं निदधाति ।
text_mt: On the right hair-boundary he places a blade of darbha grass with its point facing upward.

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhe trāyasvainam iti darbhamantardadhāti |
meaning: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इति दर्भमन्तर्दधाति ।
text_mt: With 'O plant, protect him,' he places the blade of darbha grass in between.

sanskrit_iast: svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīr iti kṣureṇābhinidadhāti |
meaning: स्वधिते मैनं हिंसीर् इति क्षुरेणाभिनिदधाति ।
text_mt: With 'O axe, do not harm him,' he presses upon it with the razor.

sanskrit_iast: yenāvapatsavitā kṣureṇa somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān | tena brahmāṇo vapatedam asyāyuṣmān ayaṃ jaradaṣṭir yathāsat | ahamasau | iti pravapati |
meaning: येनावपत्सविता क्षुरेण सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य विद्वान् । तेन ब्रह्माणो वपतेदम् अस्यायुष्मान् अयं जरदष्टिर् यथासत् । अहमसौ । इति प्रवपति ।
text_mt: With 'With which razor Savitṛ, the knowing, shaved of King Soma and of Varuṇa, / with that, O brāhmaṇas, shave this [head] of his, so that he may be long-lived, reaching old age; / I am so-and-so,' / thus he shaves.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato mātānyā vāvidhavānaḍuhena gomayenābhūmigatān keśān parigṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: दक्षिणतो मातान्या वाविधवानडुहेन गोमयेनाभूमिगतान् केशान् परिगृह्णीयात् ।
text_mt: To the south, the mother or another non-widowed woman should catch the hairs, before they reach the ground, with bull's dung.

sanskrit_iast: mā te keśān anugād varca etattathā dhātā dadhātu te | tubhyamindro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā varca ādadhuḥ | iti prapatato 'numantrayate |
meaning: मा ते केशान् अनुगाद् वर्च एतत्तथा धाता दधातु ते । तुभ्यमिन्द्रो वरुणो बृहस्पतिः सविता वर्च आदधुः । इति प्रपततो ऽनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: 'May this brilliance not go away following your hair; so may the Creator ordain for you. / May Indra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, and Savitṛ bestow brilliance upon you,' / thus he recites over them as they fall.

sanskrit_iast: tena dharmeṇa punar apo 'bhimantryāparaṃ keśāntam abhyundyād uttaraṃ ca |
meaning: तेन धर्मेण पुनर् अपो ऽभिमन्त्र्यापरं केशान्तम् अभ्युन्द्याद् उत्तरं च ।
text_mt: According to that rule, having addressed the waters again, he should moisten the rear hair-boundary and the northern one.

sanskrit_iast: anyau tu pravapanau yena pūṣā bṛhaspater agner indrasya cāyuṣe 'vapat | tena te vapāmyāyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya svastaye | iti paścāt | yena bhūyaś caratyayaṃ jyok ca paśyasi sūryam | tena te vapāmy āyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya suślokyāya suvarcase | ityuttarataḥ |
meaning: अन्यौ तु प्रवपनौ येन पूषा बृहस्पतेर् अग्नेर् इन्द्रस्य चायुषे ऽवपत् । तेन ते वपाम्यायुषे दीर्घायुत्वाय स्वस्तये । इति पश्चात् । येन भूयश् चरत्ययं ज्योक् च पश्यसि सूर्यम् । तेन ते वपाम्य् आयुषे दीर्घायुत्वाय सुश्लोक्याय सुवर्चसे । इत्युत्तरतः ।

sanskrit_iast: yat kṣureṇa parcayatā supeśasā vaptar vapasi keśān | śundha śiro māsyāyuḥ pramoṣīḥ | iti lohāyasaṃ kṣuraṃ keśavāpāya prayacchati |
meaning: यत् क्षुरेण पर्चयता सुपेशसा वप्तर् वपसि केशान् । शुन्ध शिरो मास्यायुः प्रमोषीः । इति लोहायसं क्षुरं केशवापाय प्रयच्छति ।
text_mt: With 'With which razor, shining and well-formed, thou, O shaver, shavest the hair, / cleanse his head; do not steal away his life,' / he hands over the copper or iron razor to the barber.

sanskrit_iast: yathārthaṃ keśayatnān kurvanti dakṣiṇataḥ kapardā vasiṣṭhānām ubhayato 'tribhārgavakāśyapānāṃ pañcacūḍā āṅgirasaḥ śikhino 'nye |
meaning: यथार्थं केशयत्नान् कुर्वन्ति दक्षिणतः कपर्दा वसिष्ठानाम् उभयतो ऽत्रिभार्गवकाश्यपानां पञ्चचूडा आङ्गिरसः शिखिनो ऽन्ये ।
text_mt: They arrange the hair according to custom: braids on the right side for the Vasiṣṭhas, on both sides for the Atris, Bhārgavas, and Kāśyapas, five crests for the Āṅgirases, [and] topknots for others.

sanskrit_iast: vājim eke maṅgalārtham |
meaning: वाजिम् एके मङ्गलार्थम् ।
text_mt: Some [arrange a tuft like] a horse's mane for good fortune.

sanskrit_iast: tryāyuṣaṃ kaśyapasya jamadagnes tryāyuṣam agastyasya tryāyuṣam | yad devānāṃ tryāyuṣaṃ tan me astu śatāyuṣam | iti śiraḥ saṃmṛśati |
meaning: त्र्यायुषं कश्यपस्य जमदग्नेस् त्र्यायुषम् अगस्त्यस्य त्र्यायुषम् । यद् देवानां त्र्यायुषं तन् मे अस्तु शतायुषम् । इति शिरः संमृशति ।
text_mt: 'The triple life of Kaśyapa, the triple life of Jamadagni, the triple life of Agastya, / what is the triple life of the gods, may that be my life of a hundred years,' / thus he touches the head.

sanskrit_iast: parigṛhya gomayena keśān uttarapūrvasyāṃ gṛhasya mūṣyām antarā gehāt paladaṃ ca nidadhyāt | arikte vā vapane | uptvāya keśāntān varuṇāya rājño bṛhaspatiḥ savitā viṣṇurindraḥ | tebhyo nidhānaṃ mahad anvavindann antarā dyāvāpṛthivī apa svaḥ |
meaning: परिगृह्य गोमयेन केशान् उत्तरपूर्वस्यां गृहस्य मूष्याम् अन्तरा गेहात् पलदं च निदध्यात् । अरिक्ते वा वपने । उप्त्वाय केशान्तान् वरुणाय राज्ञो बृहस्पतिः सविता विष्णुरिन्द्रः । तेभ्यो निधानं महद् अन्वविन्दन्न् अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी अप स्वः ।
text_mt: Having gathered the hair with cow dung, he should place it in the northeastern part of the house, in a reed-basket inside the house, with straw; / or in an unemptied vessel: / 'Having cut the hair-ends for King Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, Savitṛ, Viṣṇu, and Indra / found for them a great hiding place between heaven and earth, the waters, [and] heaven.'

sanskrit_iast: iti | kartre varaṃ dadāti |
meaning: इति । कर्त्रे वरं ददाति ।
text_mt: Thus. / He gives a choice gift to the performer [of the rite].

sanskrit_iast: pakṣmaguṇaṃ tilapiśitaṃ ca keśavāpāya prayacchati |
meaning: पक्ष्मगुणं तिलपिशितं च केशवापाय प्रयच्छति ।
text_mt: He gives a dish of sesamum paste to the barber.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ mātā nāmlāya dhārayet | roṣāya nāśnīyāt | lavaṇavarjaṃ tūṣṇīm |
meaning: संवत्सरं माता नाम्लाय धारयेत् । रोषाय नाश्नीयात् । लवणवर्जं तूष्णीम् ।
text_mt: For a year, the mother should not wear soiled clothes, / should not eat to satisfy anger, / [eating] silently, without salt.

sanskrit_iast: kanyāyā āhutivarjam |
meaning: कन्याया आहुतिवर्जम् ।

sanskrit_iast: viduṣo brāhmaṇān arthasiddhiṃ vācayet |
meaning: विदुषो ब्राह्मणान् अर्थसिद्धिं वाचयेत् ।
text_mt:
He should make learned brāhmaṇas recite wishes for the success of the purpose.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 5
He should initiate a brāhmaṇa in the eighth year from conception, / or in the sixth, seventh, or fifth.

sanskrit_iast: evam uttareṣu |
meaning: एवम् उत्तरेषु ।

sanskrit_iast: garbhāṣṭameṣu brāhmaṇamupanayet | ṣaṣṭhe saptame pañcame vā |
meaning: गर्भाष्टमेषु ब्राह्मणमुपनयेत् । षष्ठे सप्तमे पञ्चमे वा ।

sanskrit_iast: tato garbhaikādaśeṣu kṣatriyaṃ garbhadvādaśeṣu vaiśyam |
meaning: ततो गर्भैकादशेषु क्षत्रियं गर्भद्वादशेषु वैश्यम् ।
text_mt: Then a kṣatriya in the eleventh year from conception; a vaiśya in the twelfth year from conception.

sanskrit_iast: prākṣoḍaśād varṣād brāhmaṇasyāpatitā sāvitrī dvāviṃśāt kṣatriyasya caturviṃśād vaiśyasya | ata ūrdhvaṃ patitasāvitrikā bhavanti | nainān yājayeyur nādhyāpayeyur na vivaheyur na vivāhayeyuḥ |
meaning: प्राक्षोडशाद् वर्षाद् ब्राह्मणस्यापतिता सावित्री द्वाविंशात् क्षत्रियस्य चतुर्विंशाद् वैश्यस्य । अत ऊर्ध्वं पतितसावित्रिका भवन्ति । नैनान् याजयेयुर् नाध्यापयेयुर् न विवहेयुर् न विवाहयेयुः ।
text_mt: Until the sixteenth year, the Sāvitrī verse is not lapsed for a Brahmin; until the twenty-second for a Kṣatriya; until the twenty-fourth for a Vaiśya. / Beyond this they become ones for whom the Sāvitrī verse has lapsed. / One should not perform sacrifices for them, nor teach them, nor give them in marriage, nor marry [their women].

sanskrit_iast: abhyantaraṃ jaṭākaraṇaṃ bahir upanayanam |
meaning: अभ्यन्तरं जटाकरणं बहिर् उपनयनम् ।
text_mt: The making of the matted hair is performed indoors; the initiation [takes place] outdoors.

sanskrit_iast: ukto 'gnisaṃskāro brahmaṇaśca |
meaning: उक्तो ऽग्निसंस्कारो ब्रह्मणश्च ।
text_mt: The preparation of the fire and of the Brahman priest has [already] been stated.

sanskrit_iast: kumāraṃ paryuptinaṃ snātam abhyaktaśirasam upasparśanakalpe nopaspṛṣṭam agnerdakṣiṇato 'vasthāpya dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam iti dadhnaḥ kumāraṃ triḥ prāśayet |
meaning: कुमारं पर्युप्तिनं स्नातम् अभ्यक्तशिरसम् उपस्पर्शनकल्पे नोपस्पृष्टम् अग्नेर्दक्षिणतो ऽवस्थाप्य दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषम् इति दध्नः कुमारं त्रिः प्राशयेत् ।
text_mt: Having placed the boy—who has had his hair shorn all round, has bathed, has had his head anointed, and has touched [water] according to the rule for sipping water—to the south of the fire, he makes the boy consume curd three times with the words: "I have praised Dadhikrāvan..."

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ duruktāt paribādhamānā varṇaṃ pavitraṃ punatī na āgāt | prāṇāpānābhyāṃ balam ābhajantī śivā devī subhagā mekhaleyam | ṛtasya goptrī tapasas tarutrī ghnatī rakṣaḥ sahamānā arātīḥ | sā mā samantam anuparyehi bhadre dhartāras te subhage mekhale mā riṣāma | iti mauñjīṃ triguṇāṃ triḥ parivītāṃ mekhalām ābadhnīte | maurvīṃ dhanurjyāṃ kṣatriyasya śāṇīṃ vaiśyasya |
meaning: इयं दुरुक्तात् परिबाधमाना वर्णं पवित्रं पुनती न आगात् । प्राणापानाभ्यां बलम् आभजन्ती शिवा देवी सुभगा मेखलेयम् । ऋतस्य गोप्त्री तपसस् तरुत्री घ्नती रक्षः सहमाना अरातीः । सा मा समन्तम् अनुपर्येहि भद्रे धर्तारस् ते सुभगे मेखले मा रिषाम । इति मौञ्जीं त्रिगुणां त्रिः परिवीतां मेखलाम् आबध्नीते । मौर्वीं धनुर्ज्यां क्षत्रियस्य शाणीं वैश्यस्य ।
text_mt: "Ward off malicious speech, purifying our skin, a purifying strainer has come to us, / conferring strength upon incoming and outgoing breath, auspicious, divine, fortunate is this girdle. / Protectress of truth, crosser of austerity, slaying demons, overpowering enemies— / so encircle me completely, O auspicious one; may we, its upholders, O fortunate girdle, not suffer harm." / With these words he ties on a threefold girdle of muñja grass, wound thrice round; / a bowstring of mūrvā for a Kṣatriya; one of hemp for a Vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: upavītam asi yajñasya tvopavītenopavyayāmīti yajñopavītam |
meaning: उपवीतम् असि यज्ञस्य त्वोपवीतेनोपव्ययामीति यज्ञोपवीतम् ।
text_mt: [He puts on] the sacred thread with the words: "A sacrificial cord are you; with the sacrificial cord of the sacrifice I invest you."

sanskrit_iast: yā akṛtan yā atanvan yā avāyan yā avāharan | yāś cāgnā devīr antān abhito 'tanvata tāstvā devīr jarase saṃvyayantām | āyuṣmān ayaṃ paridhatta vāsaḥ paridhatta varcaḥ | śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuhi dīrghamāyuḥ | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīr vasūni cāyyo vibhajāya jīyān | ity ahataṃ vāsa ācchādya mitrasya cakṣurdharaṇaṃ balīyastejo yaśasvi sthaviraṃ ca dhṛṣṇu | anāhanasyaṃ vasanaṃ cariṣṇu parīdaṃ vājyaṃ vājinaṃ dadhe 'ham | iti kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca |
meaning: या अकृतन् या अतन्वन् या अवायन् या अवाहरन् । याश् चाग्ना देवीर् अन्तान् अभितो ऽतन्वत तास्त्वा देवीर् जरसे संव्ययन्ताम् । आयुष्मान् अयं परिधत्त वासः परिधत्त वर्चः । शतायुषं कृणुहि दीर्घमायुः । शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूचीर् वसूनि चाय्यो विभजाय जीयान् । इत्य् अहतं वास आच्छाद्य मित्रस्य चक्षुर्धरणं बलीयस्तेजो यशस्वि स्थविरं च धृष्णु । अनाहनस्यं वसनं चरिष्णु परीदं वाज्यं वाजिनं दधे ऽहम् । इति कृष्णाजिनं च ।
text_mt: "Those [goddesses] who spun, who stretched the warp, who wove, who drew it out, / and the goddesses who stretched the ends around the fire, may those goddesses clothe you for old age. / Long-lived, put on this garment; put on radiance; / make him long-lived, of a hundred years of life. / Live a hundred abundant autumns, and victorious, having grown great, distribute wealth!" / Having clothed him with an unwashed garment with these words, and with the words: "Mitra's eye, a powerful support, splendorous, renowned, firm, and bold, / an unrestrained garment, roaming, possessing speed—this swift [skin] I put around [you]," / [he clothes him] with a black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvāṣṭau jaṭākaraṇīyān juhuyāt |
meaning: आज्यं संस्कृत्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य समिधम् आधायाघाराव् आघार्याज्यभागौ हुत्वाष्टौ जटाकरणीयान् जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: Having prepared the clarified butter, invited the Brahman priest, placed a kindling stick, poured the two libations of clarified butter, and offered the two portions of clarified butter, he should offer the eight [oblations] pertaining to the making of the matted hair,

sanskrit_iast: vyāhṛtibhiśca |
meaning: व्याहृतिभिश्च ।

sanskrit_iast: uktaḥ karmāntaḥ pūrveṇa |
meaning: उक्तः कर्मान्तः पूर्वेण ।
text_mt: The conclusion of the ritual has been stated by the earlier [description].

sanskrit_iast: kālāya vāṃ gotrāya vāṃ jaitrāya vām audbhetrāya vām annādyāya vām avanenijed ity udakenāñjaliṃ pūrayitvā sukṛtāya vāmiti pāṇī prakṣālya idamahaṃ duryamanyā niṣplāvayāmīty ācamya niṣṭhīvati |
meaning: कालाय वां गोत्राय वां जैत्राय वाम् औद्भेत्राय वाम् अन्नाद्याय वाम् अवनेनिजेद् इत्य् उदकेनाञ्जलिं पूरयित्वा सुकृताय वामिति पाणी प्रक्षाल्य इदमहं दुर्यमन्या निष्प्लावयामीत्य् आचम्य निष्ठीवति ।
text_mt: Having filled his hollowed hands with water with the formula: "For time, for your lineage, for your victory, for your emergence, for your food... may he wash [his hands]," and having washed his hands with the words: "For your good deed," [and] having sipped water with the words: "Herewith I wash out evil thought," he spits.

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛvyāṇāṃ sapatnānām ahaṃ bhūyāsam uttama iti dvitīyam |
meaning: भ्रातृव्याणां सपत्नानाम् अहं भूयासम् उत्तम इति द्वितीयम् ।
text_mt: A second time with the words: "May I be the highest of rival brethren."

sanskrit_iast: prātar jitaṃ bhagamugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putram aditeryo vidhartā | ādhraś cidyaṃ mantamānasturaś cidrājā cidyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣīmahīty āha | ity ādityam upatiṣṭheta |
meaning: प्रातर् जितं भगमुग्रं हुवेम वयं पुत्रम् अदितेर्यो विधर्ता । आध्रश् चिद्यं मन्तमानस्तुरश् चिद्राजा चिद्यं भगं भक्षीमहीत्य् आह । इत्य् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठेत ।
text_mt: "In the morning we summon victorious, fierce Bhaga, we [summon] the son of Aditi who is the sustainer, / whom the destitute man, thinking [of him], the swift man, and the king [summon], saying: 'May we obtain Bhaga.'" / With these words he should attend upon the sun.

sanskrit_iast: brahmacaryam upāgāmupa mā hvayasveti brūyāt |
meaning: ब्रह्मचर्यम् उपागामुप मा ह्वयस्वेति ब्रूयात् ।
text_mt: [The boy] should say: "I have entered upon studenthood; call me near."

sanskrit_iast: ehi brahmopehi brahma brahma tvā sa brahmasantam upanayāmy aham asāv iti |
meaning: एहि ब्रह्मोपेहि ब्रह्म ब्रह्म त्वा स ब्रह्मसन्तम् उपनयाम्य् अहम् असाव् इति ।
text_mt: "Come, O Brahman! Approach, O Brahman! You who are the Veda, being the Veda, I initiate you, so-and-so," [the teacher replies].

sanskrit_iast: athāsyābhivādanīyaṃ nāma gṛhṇāti |
meaning: अथास्याभिवादनीयं नाम गृह्णाति ।
text_mt: Then he takes his name for saluting.

sanskrit_iast: devasya te savituḥ prasave 'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāmy aham asāv ity asya hastaṃ dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇam uttānam abhīvāṅguṣṭham abhīva lomāni gṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: देवस्य ते सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां हस्तं गृह्णाम्य् अहम् असाव् इत्य् अस्य हस्तं दक्षिणेन दक्षिणम् उत्तानम् अभीवाङ्गुष्ठम् अभीव लोमानि गृह्णीयात् ।
text_mt: With the words: "At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take your hand, so-and-so," he should grasp his right hand with his right hand, turned upwards, grasping the thumb and grasping the hairs [on the hand].

sanskrit_iast: mām evānvetu te mano māmevāpi tvam anvihi | agnau dhṛtamiva dīpyatāṃ hṛdayaṃ tava yan mayi | ityenaṃ prekṣamāṇaṃ samīkṣate |
meaning: माम् एवान्वेतु ते मनो मामेवापि त्वम् अन्विहि । अग्नौ धृतमिव दीप्यतां हृदयं तव यन् मयि । इत्येनं प्रेक्षमाणं समीक्षते ।
text_mt: "Let your mind follow mine alone; follow you also me alone. / Held as it were in the fire, let your heart burn, which is in me." / With these words he looks at him while [the boy] looks at him.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhato 'sya pāṇim anvavahṛtya hṛdayadeśam anvārabhya japet prāṇānāṃ granthir asi sa mā visrasad iti | brahmaṇo granthirasīti nābhideśam |
meaning: पृष्ठतो ऽस्य पाणिम् अन्ववहृत्य हृदयदेशम् अन्वारभ्य जपेत् प्राणानां ग्रन्थिर् असि स मा विस्रसद् इति । ब्रह्मणो ग्रन्थिरसीति नाभिदेशम् ।
text_mt: Moving his hand behind [the boy's] back and touching the region of the heart, he should whisper: "You are the knot of the breaths; may it not become untied." / "You are the knot of the Brahman," [he whispers, touching] the region of the navel.

sanskrit_iast: gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnām upamaśravastamam | jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇaspata ā naḥ kṛṇvann ūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam | iti pradakṣiṇamagniṃ pariṇayet |
meaning: गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे कविं कवीनाम् उपमश्रवस्तमम् । ज्येष्ठराजं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणस्पत आ नः कृण्वन्न् ऊतिभिः सीद सादनम् । इति प्रदक्षिणमग्निं परिणयेत् ।
text_mt: "We call upon you, host-leader of the hosts, the seer among seers, having highest renown, / the supreme king, the Brahman, O Brahmaṇaspati; coming to us with your aids, sit in our abode!" / With these words he should lead him around the fire from left to right.

sanskrit_iast: paścādagner darbheṣūpaviśati dakṣiṇataśca brahmacārī |
meaning: पश्चादग्नेर् दर्भेषूपविशति दक्षिणतश्च ब्रह्मचारी ।
text_mt: He sits down on darbha grass to the west of the fire, and the Vedic student to the south.

sanskrit_iast: adhīhi bho ity upaviśya japati |
meaning: अधीहि भो इत्य् उपविश्य जपति ।
text_mt: Having sat down, [the student] whispers: "Teach, venerable sir!"

sanskrit_iast: prabhujya dakṣiṇaṃ jānuṃ pāṇī saṃdhāya darbhahastāv oṃ ity uktvā vyāhṛtīḥ sāvitrīṃ cānubrūyāt | evaṃ kāṇḍānuvacaneṣu |
meaning: प्रभुज्य दक्षिणं जानुं पाणी संधाय दर्भहस्ताव् ओं इत्य् उक्त्वा व्याहृतीः सावित्रीं चानुब्रूयात् । एवं काण्डानुवचनेषु ।
text_mt: Bending his right knee, joining his hands, holding darbha grass in both hands, having pronounced "Om", [the teacher] should recite the mystic utterances and the Sāvitrī verse. / In this same way in the recitations of the sections [of the Veda].

sanskrit_iast: tatsaviturvareṇyam iti gāyatrīṃ brāhmaṇāya | ā devo yātu savitā suratna iti triṣṭubhaṃ kṣatriyāya | yuñjate mana iti jagatīṃ vaiśyāya | paccho 'rdharcaśaḥ sarvām antataḥ |
meaning: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यम् इति गायत्रीं ब्राह्मणाय । आ देवो यातु सविता सुरत्न इति त्रिष्टुभं क्षत्रियाय । युञ्जते मन इति जगतीं वैश्याय । पच्छो ऽर्धर्चशः सर्वाम् अन्ततः ।
text_mt: The Gāyatrī verse: "That excellent [splendor] of Savitṛ..." for a Brahmin; / the Triṣṭubh verse: "May the divine Savitṛ come with good jewels..." for a Kṣatriya; / the Jagatī verse: "They harness their minds..." for a Vaiśya; / [he recites it] by quarters, by half-verses, and finally the whole [verse].

sanskrit_iast: pālāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati naiyagrodhaṃ kṣatriyāyāśvatthaṃ vaiśyāya | suśravaḥ suśravasaṃ māṃ kuru | yathā tvaṃ suśravaḥ suśravā asy evam ahaṃ suśravaḥ suśravā bhūyāsam | yathā tvaṃ devānāṃ vedasya nidhigopo 'syevamahaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ brahmaṇo nidhigopo bhūyāsamiti pratigṛhṇāti |
meaning: पालाशं दण्डं ब्राह्मणाय प्रयच्छति नैयग्रोधं क्षत्रियायाश्वत्थं वैश्याय । सुश्रवः सुश्रवसं मां कुरु । यथा त्वं सुश्रवः सुश्रवा अस्य् एवम् अहं सुश्रवः सुश्रवा भूयासम् । यथा त्वं देवानां वेदस्य निधिगोपो ऽस्येवमहं मनुष्याणां ब्रह्मणो निधिगोपो भूयासमिति प्रतिगृह्णाति ।
text_mt: He hands a staff of palāśa wood to a Brahmin, one of nyagrodha wood to a Kṣatriya, one of aśvattha wood to a Vaiśya. / "O far-famed one, make me far-famed. / Just as you, O far-famed one, are far-famed, so may I, O far-famed one, become far-famed. / Just as you are the treasure-guardian of the Veda of the gods, so may I become the treasure-guardian of the Brahman of men," with these words [the student] receives [it].

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvakapālo brāhmaṇasya kamaṇḍaluḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ kṣatriyasya nicalkalo vaiśyasya | imā āpaḥ prabharāmy ayakṣmā yakṣmacātanīḥ | ṛtenāpaḥ prabharāmy amṛtena sahāyuṣā | iti pratigṛhṇāmīti pratigṛhya bhaikṣyacaryaṃ caret bhavati bhikṣāṃ dehīti brāhmaṇaḥ bhavati madhyāṃ kṣatriyaḥ bhavaty antyāṃ vaiśyaḥ | catasraḥ ṣaḍaṣṭau vāvidhavā apratyākhyāyinyaḥ | mātaraṃ prathamameke |
meaning: ऊर्ध्वकपालो ब्राह्मणस्य कमण्डलुः परिमण्डलः क्षत्रियस्य निचल्कलो वैश्यस्य । इमा आपः प्रभराम्य् अयक्ष्मा यक्ष्मचातनीः । ऋतेनापः प्रभराम्य् अमृतेन सहायुषा । इति प्रतिगृह्णामीति प्रतिगृह्य भैक्ष्यचर्यं चरेत् भवति भिक्षां देहीति ब्राह्मणः भवति मध्यां क्षत्रियः भवत्य् अन्त्यां वैश्यः । चतस्रः षडष्टौ वाविधवा अप्रत्याख्यायिन्यः । मातरं प्रथममेके ।
text_mt: The water pot of a Brahmin has an upright bowl; that of a Kṣatriya is round; that of a Vaiśya is made of bark. / "These waters I bring forth, free from disease, driving away disease; / by cosmic order I bring forth the waters together with immortality and life." / With the words: "I receive [it]," having received it, he should go about begging alms: "Lady, give alms!"—a Brahmin [says, placing the word 'Lady' first]; a Kṣatriya [places] "Lady" in the middle; a Vaiśya [places] "Lady" at the end; / from four, six, or eight non-widowed women who will not refuse. / Some say from the mother first.

sanskrit_iast: gurave nivedya |
meaning: गुरवे निवेद्य ।

sanskrit_iast: vāgyataḥ prāg grāmāt saṃdhyām āset | tiṣṭhanpūrvām | sāvitrīṃ trir adhītya adhvanām adhvapate svastyasyādhvanaḥ pāramaśīya | yā medhā apsaraḥsu gandharveṣu ca yanmanaḥ | yā medhā daivī mānuṣī sā mām āviśatām iha | iti |
meaning: वाग्यतः प्राग् ग्रामात् संध्याम् आसेत् । तिष्ठन्पूर्वाम् । सावित्रीं त्रिर् अधीत्य अध्वनाम् अध्वपते स्वस्त्यस्याध्वनः पारमशीय । या मेधा अप्सरःसु गन्धर्वेषु च यन्मनः । या मेधा दैवी मानुषी सा माम् आविशताम् इह । इति ।
text_mt: restraining his speech, he should sit for the twilight ritual to the east of the village; / standing for the morning one. / Having recited the Sāvitrī verse three times, [he recites:] "O lord of the pathways of the pathways, may I attain welfare at the end of this path. / What wisdom is in the Apsarases, and what thought is in the Gandharvas, / what wisdom is divine and human, may that enter me here."

sanskrit_iast: pratyetyāgniṃ paricaret | imaṃ stomamarhata iti parisamūhet | edho 'sy edhiṣīmahīti samidham ādadhāti | samid asi samedhiṣīmahīti dvitīyām |
meaning: प्रत्येत्याग्निं परिचरेत् । इमं स्तोममर्हत इति परिसमूहेत् । एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहीति समिधम् आदधाति । समिद् असि समेधिषीमहीति द्वितीयाम् ।
text_mt: Having returned, he should tend the fire. / With the verse: "This praise to the worthy one..." he should sweep around [the fire]. / With the words: "You are kindling; may we kindle," he places a kindling stick [on the fire]. / With the words: "You are a kindling stick; may we flourish," a second.

sanskrit_iast: apo 'dyānvacāriṣam ityupatiṣṭhate |
meaning: अपो ऽद्यान्वचारिषम् इत्युपतिष्ठते ।
text_mt: He attends upon [the fire] with the words: "I have gone after the waters today..."

sanskrit_iast: taṃ mā saṃsṛja varcaseti mukhaṃ parimṛjīta |
meaning: तं मा संसृज वर्चसेति मुखं परिमृजीत ।
text_mt: He should wipe his face with the words: "Unite me with that radiance."

sanskrit_iast: yadagne tapasā tapo brahmacaryam upemasi | priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyasmāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ | agne samidham ahāriṣaṃ bṛhate jātavedase | sa me śraddhāṃ ca medhāṃ ca jātavedāḥ prayacchatu | svāhā | iti samidham ādadhāti |
meaning: यदग्ने तपसा तपो ब्रह्मचर्यम् उपेमसि । प्रियाः श्रुतस्य भूयस्मायुष्मन्तः सुमेधसः । अग्ने समिधम् अहारिषं बृहते जातवेदसे । स मे श्रद्धां च मेधां च जातवेदाः प्रयच्छतु । स्वाहा । इति समिधम् आदधाति ।
text_mt: "O Agni, what austerity we perform by austerity, we who have entered upon studenthood, / may we be beloved of sacred learning, long-lived, and endowed with good wisdom. / O Agni, to the great Jātavedas I have brought a kindling stick; / may that Jātavedas grant me faith and wisdom. / Svāhā!" / With these words he places a kindling stick [on the fire].

sanskrit_iast: tejasā mā samaṅgdhi varcasā mā samaṅgdhi brahmavarcasena mā samaṅgdhīti mukhaṃ parimṛjīta |
meaning: तेजसा मा समङ्ग्धि वर्चसा मा समङ्ग्धि ब्रह्मवर्चसेन मा समङ्ग्धीति मुखं परिमृजीत ।
text_mt: He should wipe his face with the words: "Anoint me with energy; anoint me with radiance; anoint me with spiritual luster!"

sanskrit_iast: āyurdhā agne 'sīti yathārūpaṃ gātrāṇi saṃmṛśati |
meaning: आयुर्धा अग्ने ऽसीति यथारूपं गात्राणि संमृशति ।
text_mt: With the words: "You are a giver of life, O Agni..." he touches his limbs according to their form.

sanskrit_iast: iha dhṛtiriti paryāyair aṃsaṃ grīvāścārcirālabhya rucaṃ no dhehīti lalāṭam abhimṛśet |
meaning: इह धृतिरिति पर्यायैर् अंसं ग्रीवाश्चार्चिरालभ्य रुचं नो धेहीति ललाटम् अभिमृशेत् ।
text_mt: With the repeated formulas beginning 'Here is stability,' having touched the flame, he should touch the shoulder and neck, and with 'Bestow radiance upon us,' he should touch the forehead.

sanskrit_iast: ādyantayoḥ paryukṣaṇam |
meaning: आद्यन्तयोः पर्युक्षणम् ।
text_mt: The sprinkling of water around [takes place] at the beginning and the end.

sanskrit_iast: gurave brahmaṇe ca varam uttarāsaṅgaṃ ca dadāti |
meaning: गुरवे ब्रह्मणे च वरम् उत्तरासङ्गं च ददाति ।
text_mt: He gives a choice gift and an upper garment to the teacher and to the Brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśarātram akṣāralavaṇam āśet |
meaning: द्वादशरात्रम् अक्षारलवणम् आशेत् ।
text_mt: For twelve nights he should eat food free from pungent seasonings and salt.

sanskrit_iast: akṣārameke |
meaning: अक्षारमेके ।

sanskrit_iast: vyuṣṭe dvādaśarātre ṣaḍrātre vā grāmāt prācīṃ vodīcīṃ vā diśam upaniṣkramya paścāt palāśasya yajñīyasya vā vṛkṣasya sāvitreṇa sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiścājyasya purastāt sviṣṭakṛto mekhalāṃ daṇḍaṃ cāpsu prāsyet |
meaning: व्युष्टे द्वादशरात्रे षड्रात्रे वा ग्रामात् प्राचीं वोदीचीं वा दिशम् उपनिष्क्रम्य पश्चात् पलाशस्य यज्ञीयस्य वा वृक्षस्य सावित्रेण स्थालीपाकेनेष्ट्वा जयप्रभृतिभिश्चाज्यस्य पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतो मेखलां दण्डं चाप्सु प्रास्येत् ।
text_mt: When the twelve nights—or six nights—have passed, having walked out of the village toward the east or the north, to the west of a palāśa tree or of a sacrificial tree, having sacrificed with a pot-cooked offering dedicated to Savitṛ and with clarified butter [accompanied] by the Jaya and following offerings before the Sviṣṭakṛt, he should throw the girdle and the staff into the water.

sanskrit_iast: tatraiva haviḥśeṣaṃ bhuñjīteti śrutiḥ |
meaning: तत्रैव हविःशेषं भुञ्जीतेति श्रुतिः ।
text_mt:
He should eat the remainder of the oblation right there; so says the sacred tradition.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra 6
From the initiation onward he should observe vows.

sanskrit_iast: upanayanaprabhṛti vratacārī syāt |
meaning: उपनयनप्रभृति व्रतचारी स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: upanayanena vratādeśā vyākhyātāḥ |
meaning: उपनयनेन व्रतादेशा व्याख्याताः ।
text_mt: By the initiation, the instructions for vows are explained.

sanskrit_iast: mārgavāsāḥ saṃhatakeśaḥ bhaikṣācaryavṛttiḥ saśalkadaṇḍaḥ saptamauñjīṃ mekhalāṃ dhārayed ācāryasyāpratikūlaḥ sarvakārī |
meaning: मार्गवासाः संहतकेशः भैक्षाचर्यवृत्तिः सशल्कदण्डः सप्तमौञ्जीं मेखलां धारयेद् आचार्यस्याप्रतिकूलः सर्वकारी ।
text_mt: Wearing deer-skin, with his hair tied together, subsisting on begged food, carrying a staff with bark, he should wear a girdle made of seven strands of muñja grass; obedient to the teacher, doing all his bidding.

sanskrit_iast: yadenam upeyāt tad asmai dadyāt | bahūnāṃ yena saṃyuktaḥ |
meaning: यदेनम् उपेयात् तद् अस्मै दद्यात् । बहूनां येन संयुक्तः ।
text_mt: Whatever comes to him, he should give that to him, / through which he is united with many.

sanskrit_iast: nāsya śayyāmāviśet |
meaning: नास्य शय्यामाविशेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: na rathamārohet |
meaning: न रथमारोहेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: na saṃvaset |
meaning: न संवसेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: na vihārārtho jalpet |
meaning: न विहारार्थो जल्पेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: na rucyarthaḥ kaṃcanaṃ dhārayet |
meaning: न रुच्यर्थः कंचनं धारयेत् ।
text_mt: He should not wear anything for the sake of adornment.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi sāṃsparśakāni strībhyo varjayet |
meaning: सर्वाणि सांस्पर्शकानि स्त्रीभ्यो वर्जयेत् ।
text_mt: He should avoid all contact with women.

sanskrit_iast: na snāyād daṇḍavat |
meaning: न स्नायाद् दण्डवत् ।

sanskrit_iast: nodakamabhyupeyāt |
meaning: नोदकमभ्युपेयात् ।

sanskrit_iast: na divā svapet |
meaning: न दिवा स्वपेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: traividyakaṃ brahmacaryaṃ caret |
meaning: त्रैविद्यकं ब्रह्मचर्यं चरेत् ।
text_mt: He should observe the Vedic studentship pertaining to the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: indriyasaṃyataḥ sāyaṃ prātar bhaikṣyavṛttiḥ |
meaning: इन्द्रियसंयतः सायं प्रातर् भैक्ष्यवृत्तिः ।
text_mt: Restraining his senses, he subsists on alms evening and morning.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃ prātar agniṃ paricaret |
meaning: सायं प्रातर् अग्निं परिचरेत् ।
text_mt: He should tend the fire evening and morning.

sanskrit_iast: adhaḥśāyī ācāryādhīnavṛttiḥ tannisargād aśanam ayācitaṃ lavaṇam |
meaning: अधःशायी आचार्याधीनवृत्तिः तन्निसर्गाद् अशनम् अयाचितं लवणम् ।
text_mt: Sleeping on the ground, dependent on the teacher for his livelihood, eating by his permission unbegged salt.

sanskrit_iast: vāgyato 'śnīyāt |
meaning: वाग्यतो ऽश्नीयात् ।

sanskrit_iast: madhumāṃse varjayet |
meaning: मधुमांसे वर्जयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: acchannavastrāṃ vivṛtāṃ striyaṃ na paśyet |
meaning: अच्छन्नवस्त्रां विवृतां स्त्रियं न पश्येत् ।
text_mt: He should not look upon a woman who is unclothed or exposed.

sanskrit_iast: yaupyasya vṛkṣasya daṇḍī syāt |
meaning: यौप्यस्य वृक्षस्य दण्डी स्यात् ।
text_mt: He should possess a staff of a tree fit for a sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: nānena praharedgave na brāhmaṇāya |
meaning: नानेन प्रहरेद्गवे न ब्राह्मणाय ।
text_mt: He should not strike a cow or a brāhmaṇa with it.

sanskrit_iast: na nṛtyagīte gacchet |
meaning: न नृत्यगीते गच्छेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: na caine kuryāt |
meaning: न चैने कुर्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: nāvalikhet |
meaning: नावलिखेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: śikhājaṭaḥ sarvajaṭo vā syāt |
meaning: शिखाजटः सर्वजटो वा स्यात् ।
text_mt: He should have a topknot of matted hair, or all matted hair.

sanskrit_iast: śāṇīkṣaumājinavāsāḥ |
meaning: शाणीक्षौमाजिनवासाः ।

sanskrit_iast: raktaṃ vasanakambalam aiṇeyaṃ brāhmaṇasya rauravaṃ kṣatriyasya ājaṃ vaiśyasya |
meaning: रक्तं वसनकम्बलम् ऐणेयं ब्राह्मणस्य रौरवं क्षत्रियस्य आजं वैश्यस्य ।
text_mt: A dyed garment or woollen blanket, [and an antelope skin] from an eṇa deer for a brāhmaṇa, from a ruru deer for a kṣatriya, of a goat for a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇa dvādaśavarṣāṇy ekavede brahmacaryaṃ caret | caturviṃśati dvayoḥ ṣaṭtriṃśati trayāṇām aṣṭācatvāriṃśati sarveṣām | yāvad grahaṇaṃ vā |
meaning: एतेन धर्मेण द्वादशवर्षाण्य् एकवेदे ब्रह्मचर्यं चरेत् । चतुर्विंशति द्वयोः षट्त्रिंशति त्रयाणाम् अष्टाचत्वारिंशति सर्वेषाम् । यावद् ग्रहणं वा ।
text_mt: According to this rule he should practice Vedic studentship for twelve years for one Veda; / twenty-four for two, thirty-six for three, forty-eight for all; / or as long as comprehension requires.

sanskrit_iast: malajñurabalaḥ kṛśaḥ snātvā sa sarvaṃ labhate yat kiṃcin manasepsitamiti |
meaning: मलज्ञुरबलः कृशः स्नात्वा स सर्वं लभते यत् किंचिन् मनसेप्सितमिति ।
text_mt: "Covered with dirt, weak, emaciated—having taken the ritual bath, he obtains everything whatever he desired in his mind."

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇa sādhv adhīte |
meaning: एतेन धर्मेण साध्व् अधीते ।
text_mt: According to this rule he studies properly.

sanskrit_iast: mantrabrāhmaṇānyadhītya kalpaṃ mīmāṃsāṃ ca yājñiko 'dhītya vaktraṃ padaṃ smṛtiṃ caicchikaḥ |
meaning: मन्त्रब्राह्मणान्यधीत्य कल्पं मीमांसां च याज्ञिको ऽधीत्य वक्त्रं पदं स्मृतिं चैच्छिकः ।
text_mt: Having studied the Mantras and Brāhmaṇas, the Kalpa, and Mīmāṃsā, [he becomes] a ritualist; having studied phonetics, grammar, and the traditional law, [he is] an optionalist.

sanskrit_iast: tau snātakau |
meaning: तौ स्नातकौ ।

sanskrit_iast: śrotriyo 'nyo vedapāṭhī | na tasya snānam |
meaning: श्रोत्रियो ऽन्यो वेदपाठी । न तस्य स्नानम् ।
text_mt: Another is a śrotriya, a mere reciter of the Veda; / for him there is no ritual bath.

sanskrit_iast: upaviśyācamanaṃ vidhīyate | antarjānu bāhū kṛtvā trir ācāmet |
meaning: उपविश्याचमनं विधीयते । अन्तर्जानु बाहू कृत्वा त्रिर् आचामेत् ।
text_mt: Rinsing the mouth is prescribed having sat down: / having placed his arms between his knees, he should sip water three times.

sanskrit_iast: dviḥ parimṛjet | khāni copaspṛśecchīrṣaṇyāni |
meaning: द्विः परिमृजेत् । खानि चोपस्पृशेच्छीर्षण्यानि ।
text_mt:
He should wipe twice, / and touch the openings of the head.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra 7
Now the consecration pertaining to the Caturhotṛ formulas lasts one year.

sanskrit_iast: atha cāturhotṛkī dīkṣā saṃvatsaram |
meaning: अथ चातुर्होतृकी दीक्षा संवत्सरम् ।

sanskrit_iast: āghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā caturhot n svakarmaṇo juhuyāt | saha pañcahotrā ṣaḍḍhotrā ca saptahotāram antataḥ |
meaning: आघाराव् आघार्याज्यभागौ हुत्वा चतुर्होत् न् स्वकर्मणो जुहुयात् । सह पञ्चहोत्रा षड्ढोत्रा च सप्तहोतारम् अन्ततः ।
text_mt: Having poured the two libations of clarified butter and offered the two portions of clarified butter, he should offer the Caturhotṛ formulas each with its own ritual act, / together with the Pañcahotṛ and the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ, and the Saptahotṛ at the end.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā vrataṃ pradāyādito dvāv anuvākāv anuvācayet |
meaning: हुत्वा व्रतं प्रदायादितो द्वाव् अनुवाकाव् अनुवाचयेत् ।
text_mt: Having offered, having conferred the observance, he should cause him to recite the first two recitation sections.

sanskrit_iast: athāgnivratāśvamedhikī dīkṣā saṃvatsaraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ vā |
meaning: अथाग्निव्रताश्वमेधिकी दीक्षा संवत्सरं द्वादशरात्रं वा ।
text_mt: Now the consecration pertaining to the Agnivrata and the Aśvamedha lasts a year or twelve nights.

sanskrit_iast: ākūtamagnimiti ṣaḍḍhutvā vrataṃ pradāyādito 'ṣṭāv anuvākān anuvācayet |
meaning: आकूतमग्निमिति षड्ढुत्वा व्रतं प्रदायादितो ऽष्टाव् अनुवाकान् अनुवाचयेत् ।
text_mt: Having offered six oblations with the formulas beginning 'Agni, the intention,' having conferred the observance, he should cause him to recite the first eight recitation sections.

sanskrit_iast: triṣavaṇam udakam āharet trīṃs trīn kumbhān |
meaning: त्रिषवणम् उदकम् आहरेत् त्रींस् त्रीन् कुम्भान् ।
text_mt: At the three pressings he should fetch water, three jars each time,

sanskrit_iast: trīṃśca samitpulān |
meaning: त्रींश्च समित्पुलान् ।

sanskrit_iast: bhasmani śayīta karīṣe sikatāsu bhūmau vā |
meaning: भस्मनि शयीत करीषे सिकतासु भूमौ वा ।
text_mt: He should sleep in ashes, dry cow-dung, sand, or on bare ground.

sanskrit_iast: nodakam abhyupeyāt |
meaning: नोदकम् अभ्युपेयात् ।

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsare samāpte ghṛtavatāpūpenāgnim iṣṭvā vātsapraṃ vācayet |
meaning: संवत्सरे समाप्ते घृतवतापूपेनाग्निम् इष्ट्वा वात्सप्रं वाचयेत् ।
text_mt: When the year is completed, having worshipped Agni with a cake accompanied by clarified butter, he should cause him to recite the Vātsapra hymn.

sanskrit_iast: smārtena yāvad adhyayanaṃ kāṇḍavrataviśeṣā homārthaś cādyantayor juhuyāt |
meaning: स्मार्तेन यावद् अध्ययनं काण्डव्रतविशेषा होमार्थश् चाद्यन्तयोर् जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: As long as the study lasts, according to the traditional rule, he should offer the specific observances of the sections and for the sake of the fire offerings at the beginning and at the end.

sanskrit_iast: athainaṃ paridadīta agnaye tvā paridadāni | vāyave tvā paridadāni | sūryāya tvā paridadāni | prajāpataye tvā paridadānīti |
meaning: अथैनं परिददीत अग्नये त्वा परिददानि । वायवे त्वा परिददानि । सूर्याय त्वा परिददानि । प्रजापतये त्वा परिददानीति ।
text_mt: Then he should entrust him: 'To Agni I entrust you; / to Vāyu I entrust you; / to Sūrya I entrust you; / to Prajāpati I entrust you.'

sanskrit_iast: etenaivāśvamedho vyākhyātaḥ |
meaning: एतेनैवाश्वमेधो व्याख्यातः ।
text_mt: By this very [rite] the Aśvamedha is explained.

sanskrit_iast: navamenānuvākena hutvā daśamenopatiṣṭheta |
meaning: नवमेनानुवाकेन हुत्वा दशमेनोपतिष्ठेत ।
text_mt: Having offered with the ninth recitation section, he should revere [the fire] with the tenth.

sanskrit_iast: aśvāya ghāsamudakasthānam udakaṃ cābhyupeyāt |
meaning: अश्वाय घासमुदकस्थानम् उदकं चाभ्युपेयात् ।
text_mt: He should approach the horse with fodder, a place of water, and water.

sanskrit_iast: etābhyām evamantrābhyāṃ traividyakaṃ vratamupeyāt |
meaning: एताभ्याम् एवमन्त्राभ्यां त्रैविद्यकं व्रतमुपेयात् ।
text_mt: With these two [rites] and with these formulas, he should undertake the observance pertaining to the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: rahasyamadhyeṣyatā pravargyaḥ |
meaning: रहस्यमध्येष्यता प्रवर्ग्यः ।
text_mt: For one who is about to study the esoteric doctrine, [there is] the Pravargya rite.

sanskrit_iast: tasya rahasye vratopāyanaṃ saminmantraśca |
meaning: तस्य रहस्ये व्रतोपायनं समिन्मन्त्रश्च ।
text_mt: The assumption of the observance and the mantra for the kindling stick for it are [found] in the secret text.

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhed ahani rātrāv āsīta vāgyataḥ |
meaning: तिष्ठेद् अहनि रात्राव् आसीत वाग्यतः ।
text_mt: He should stand by day, sit by night, keeping silent.

sanskrit_iast: parvasu caivaṃ syāt |
meaning: पर्वसु चैवं स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: sarvajaṭaśca syāt |
meaning: सर्वजटश्च स्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarāvaraḥ pravargyo bhavati |
meaning: संवत्सरावरः प्रवर्ग्यो भवति ।
text_mt:
The Pravargya rite [observance] lasts at least one year.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 8 / In the rainy season under [the asterism] Śravaṇa he inaugurates the study [of the Vedas]; / or under Hasta; / under the full moon of Prauṣṭhapada, say some.

sanskrit_iast: varṣāsu śravaṇenādhyāyān upākaroti | hastena vā | prauṣṭhapadīm ityeke |
meaning: वर्षासु श्रवणेनाध्यायान् उपाकरोति । हस्तेन वा । प्रौष्ठपदीम् इत्येके ।

sanskrit_iast: atha juhoti | apvā nāmāsi tasyāste joṣṭrīṃ gameyam | aham iddhi pituḥ pari medhā amṛtasya jagrabha | ahaṃ sūrya ivājani | svāhā | apvo nāmāsi tasya te joṣṭraṃ gameyam | aham iddhi pituḥ pari medhā amṛtasya jagrabha | ahaṃ sūrya ivājani | svāhā | iti |
meaning: अथ जुहोति । अप्वा नामासि तस्यास्ते जोष्ट्रीं गमेयम् । अहम् इद्धि पितुः परि मेधा अमृतस्य जग्रभ । अहं सूर्य इवाजनि । स्वाहा । अप्वो नामासि तस्य ते जोष्ट्रं गमेयम् । अहम् इद्धि पितुः परि मेधा अमृतस्य जग्रभ । अहं सूर्य इवाजनि । स्वाहा । इति ।
text_mt: Then he offers: / ‘Apvā is your name; may I reach your affection. / Truly from my father I have grasped wisdom of the immortal; / I have been born like the sun; / svāhā! / Apva is your name; may I reach your affection. / Truly from my father I have grasped wisdom of the immortal; / I have been born like the sun; / svāhā!’ / thus.

sanskrit_iast: yuktirnāmāsi | yogo nāmāsi | matir nāmāsi | sumatirnāmāsi | sarasvatī nāmāsi | sarasvān nāmāsi | tasyāste tasya te ity anuṣajet |
meaning: युक्तिर्नामासि । योगो नामासि । मतिर् नामासि । सुमतिर्नामासि । सरस्वती नामासि । सरस्वान् नामासि । तस्यास्ते तस्य ते इत्य् अनुषजेत् ।
text_mt: ‘Yukti is your name; / Yoga is your name; / Mati is your name; / Sumati is your name; / Sarasvatī is your name; / Sarasvat is your name;’ / he should append: ‘[may I reach affection] of yours [f.]’, ‘of yours [m.]’.

sanskrit_iast: yuje svāhā | prayuje svāhā | saṃyuje svāhā | udyuje svāhā | udyujyamānāya svāheti jayaprabhṛtibhiś cājyasya purastāt sviṣṭakṛto 'ntevāsināṃ yogam icchann atha japati ṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi brahma vadiṣyāmi tan mām avatu tadvaktāram avatv avatu māmavatu vaktāram | vāṅ me manasi pratiṣṭhitā mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitam āvir āyur mayi dhehi | vedasya vāṇī stha | upatiṣṭhantu chandāṃsy upākurmahe 'dhyāyān |
meaning: युजे स्वाहा । प्रयुजे स्वाहा । संयुजे स्वाहा । उद्युजे स्वाहा । उद्युज्यमानाय स्वाहेति जयप्रभृतिभिश् चाज्यस्य पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतो ऽन्तेवासिनां योगम् इच्छन्न् अथ जपति ऋतं वदिष्यामि सत्यं वदिष्यामि ब्रह्म वदिष्यामि तन् माम् अवतु तद्वक्तारम् अवत्व् अवतु मामवतु वक्तारम् । वाङ् मे मनसि प्रतिष्ठिता मनो मे वाचि प्रतिष्ठितम् आविर् आयुर् मयि धेहि । वेदस्य वाणी स्थ । उपतिष्ठन्तु छन्दांस्य् उपाकुर्महे ऽध्यायान् ।
text_mt: ‘To the yoked one, svāhā! / To the applied one, svāhā! / To the conjoined one, svāhā! / To the rising one, svāhā! / To the one being undertaken, svāhā!’—and with [the formulas] beginning with the Jayas [he makes offerings] of clarified butter before the Sviṣṭakṛt, desiring the conjunction [in study] of his pupils. Then he murmurs: ‘I will speak what is right; I will speak what is true; I will speak the sacred word; may that protect me; may that protect the speaker; protect me, protect the speaker! / My speech is established in my mind; my mind is established in my speech; place manifest life in me! / You are the voice of the Veda; / may the meters attend [us]; we inaugurate the study.’

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svariti darbhapāṇis triḥ sāvitrīm adhītyāditaś ca trīn anuvākāṃs tathāṅgānām ekaikam | ko vo yunaktīti ca |
meaning: ओं भूर् भुवः स्वरिति दर्भपाणिस् त्रिः सावित्रीम् अधीत्यादितश् च त्रीन् अनुवाकांस् तथाङ्गानाम् एकैकम् । को वो युनक्तीति च ।
text_mt: Saying ‘Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ’, holding darbha grass in his hands, reciting the Sāvitrī verse three times, and from the beginning [of the Veda] three recitation sections, and likewise one [section] of each of the auxiliary sciences; / and ‘Who yokes you?’

sanskrit_iast: tasyānadhyāyāḥ | sataḥ valīkakṣāraprabhṛti varṣaṃ na vidyotamāne na stanayatīti śrutiḥ ākālikaṃ devatu mūlaṃ vidyuddhanvolkātyakṣarāḥ śabdāḥ ācāreṇānye |
meaning: तस्यानध्यायाः । सतः वलीकक्षारप्रभृति वर्षं न विद्योतमाने न स्तनयतीति श्रुतिः आकालिकं देवतु मूलं विद्युद्धन्वोल्कात्यक्षराः शब्दाः आचारेणान्ये ।
text_mt: Suspensions of study for it: / when it begins to rain [so heavily as] to drip from the eaves, while there is no lightning and no thunder—so the sacred tradition says; a sudden [storm until the same time next day]; lightning, a rainbow, meteors, and extraordinary sounds [cause a suspension] until the same time next day; others [are known] through customary practice.

sanskrit_iast: ardhapañcamān māsān adhītya pañcārdhaṣaṣṭhān vā dīkṣaṇāyanaṃ vādhītyāthotsṛjanty etena dharmeṇa ṛtam avādiṣaṃ satyam avādiṣaṃ brahmāvādiṣaṃ tan mām āvīt tadvaktāram āvīd āvīn mām āvīd vaktāram | vāṅ me manasi pratiṣṭhitā mano me vāci pratiṣṭhitam āvir āyur mayi dhehi | vedasya vāṇī stha | pratiśvasantu chandāṃsy utsṛjāmahe 'dhyāyān |
meaning: अर्धपञ्चमान् मासान् अधीत्य पञ्चार्धषष्ठान् वा दीक्षणायनं वाधीत्याथोत्सृजन्त्य् एतेन धर्मेण ऋतम् अवादिषं सत्यम् अवादिषं ब्रह्मावादिषं तन् माम् आवीत् तद्वक्तारम् आवीद् आवीन् माम् आवीद् वक्तारम् । वाङ् मे मनसि प्रतिष्ठिता मनो मे वाचि प्रतिष्ठितम् आविर् आयुर् मयि धेहि । वेदस्य वाणी स्थ । प्रतिश्वसन्तु छन्दांस्य् उत्सृजामहे ऽध्यायान् ।
text_mt: Having studied for four and a half months, or five and a half months, or having studied during the northern course [of the sun], they then suspend Vedic study according to this rule: ‘I have spoken what is right; I have spoken what is true; I have spoken the sacred word; that has protected me; that has protected the speaker; it has protected me, it has protected the speaker! / My speech is established in my mind; my mind is established in my speech; place manifest life in me! / You are the voice of the Veda; / may the meters breathe anew; we suspend the study.’

sanskrit_iast: oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar ity antam adhītya ko vo vimuñcatīti ca |
meaning: ओं भूर् भुवः स्वर् इत्य् अन्तम् अधीत्य को वो विमुञ्चतीति च ।
text_mt: Having recited to the end, saying ‘Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ’, and ‘Who unyokes you?’

sanskrit_iast: pakṣiṇīṃ rātrīṃ nādhīyīta | ubhayataḥ pakṣāṃ vā |
meaning: पक्षिणीं रात्रीं नाधीयीत । उभयतः पक्षां वा ।
text_mt: He should not study during a night with the two days [on either side]; / or during [the days bordering] a fortnight on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: nāta ūrdhvamabhreṣu |
meaning: नात ऊर्ध्वमभ्रेषु ।

sanskrit_iast: ākālikavidyutstanayitnuvarṣaṃ varṣaṃ ca |
meaning: आकालिकविद्युत्स्तनयित्नुवर्षं वर्षं च ।
text_mt: [nor during] rain with lightning and thunder lasting until the same time next day, and during [ordinary] rain.

sanskrit_iast: athopaniṣadarhāḥ | brahmacārī sucaritī medhāvī karmakṛd dhanadaḥ priyaḥ vidyayā vā vidyām anvicchan |
meaning: अथोपनिषदर्हाः । ब्रह्मचारी सुचरिती मेधावी कर्मकृद् धनदः प्रियः विद्यया वा विद्याम् अन्विच्छन् ।
text_mt: Now, those worthy of the Upaniṣad: / a Vedic student, of good conduct, intelligent, diligent, a giver of wealth, dear, or one seeking knowledge through knowledge.

sanskrit_iast: tāni tīrthāni brahmaṇaḥ |
meaning: तानि तीर्थानि ब्रह्मणः ।
text_mt:
These are the fit recipients for the sacred word.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 9 / The first shaving of the beard is for one sixteen years old; / or for one about to study the fire [ritual]; / according to a Maitrāyaṇīya, it is the fire-shaving.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśavarṣasya godānam | agniṃ vādhyeṣyamāṇasya | agnigodāno maitrāyaṇiḥ |
meaning: षोडशवर्षस्य गोदानम् । अग्निं वाध्येष्यमाणस्य । अग्निगोदानो मैत्रायणिः ।

sanskrit_iast: jaṭākaraṇenokto mantravidhiḥ |
meaning: जटाकरणेनोक्तो मन्त्रविधिः ।
text_mt: The ritual rule for the mantras has been explained by [the rite of] making the matted hair.

sanskrit_iast: upastha upakakṣayoś cādhiko mantraprayogaḥ | yat kṣureṇa parcayatā supeśasā vaptar vapasi keśaśmaśrūn | śundha śiro mukhaṃ māsyāyuḥ pramoṣīḥ | iti |
meaning: उपस्थ उपकक्षयोश् चाधिको मन्त्रप्रयोगः । यत् क्षुरेण पर्चयता सुपेशसा वप्तर् वपसि केशश्मश्रून् । शुन्ध शिरो मुखं मास्यायुः प्रमोषीः । इति ।
text_mt: And in the lap and at the armpits there is an additional application of the mantra: / ‘Wherewith, O barber, with the sharp, well-formed razor thou shavest hair and beard; / cleanse his head and face, do not rob him of his life!’ / thus.

sanskrit_iast: bhūmau keśān nikhanet |
meaning: भूमौ केशान् निखनेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: ante gāṃ dadyāt |
meaning: अन्ते गां दद्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: vede guruṇānujñātaḥ snāyāt |
meaning: वेदे गुरुणानुज्ञातः स्नायात् ।
text_mt: Permitted by the teacher regarding the Veda, he should take the ritual bath.

sanskrit_iast: chandasy arthān buddhvā snāsyan gāṃ kārayet |
meaning: छन्दस्य् अर्थान् बुद्ध्वा स्नास्यन् गां कारयेत् ।
text_mt: Having understood the meanings in the meter, about to take the ritual bath, he should have a cow [presented].

sanskrit_iast: ācāryamarhayet |
meaning: आचार्यमर्हयेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: āpo hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucaya iti catasṛbhiḥ snātvāhate vāsasī paridadhīta vasvasi vasumantaṃ māṃ kuru sauvarcasāya vāṃ tejase brahmavarcasāya paridadhānīti |
meaning: आपो हि ष्ठेति तिसृभिः हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचय इति चतसृभिः स्नात्वाहते वाससी परिदधीत वस्वसि वसुमन्तं मां कुरु सौवर्चसाय वां तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय परिदधानीति ।
text_mt: Having bathed with the three [verses], ‘You waters are indeed [refreshing]’, and with the four [verses], ‘Golden-colored, pure’, he should put on two unwashed garments [with the formulas]: ‘You are wealth, make me wealthy!’ and ‘I put on you two for brilliance, splendor, and holy luster!’

sanskrit_iast: viśvajanasya chāyāsīti chattraṃ dhārayate |
meaning: विश्वजनस्य छायासीति छत्त्रं धारयते ।
text_mt: He holds an umbrella, with [the formula]: ‘You are the shade for all people.’

sanskrit_iast: mālāmābadhnīte yām aśvinau dhārayetāṃ bṛhatīṃ puṣkarasrajam | tāṃ viśvair devair anumatāṃ mālāmāropayāmi | iti |
meaning: मालामाबध्नीते याम् अश्विनौ धारयेतां बृहतीं पुष्करस्रजम् । तां विश्वैर् देवैर् अनुमतां मालामारोपयामि । इति ।
text_mt: He binds on a garland, with [the formula]: ‘Which great lotus garland the two Aśvins wore, / that garland approved by All the Gods I put on.’ / Thus.

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'sīti hiraṇyaṃ bibhṛyāt |
meaning: तेजो ऽसीति हिरण्यं बिभृयात् ।
text_mt: He should wear gold, with [the formula]: ‘You are splendor.’

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhe stho devate mā mā saṃtāptam ityupānahau |
meaning: प्रतिष्ठे स्थो देवते मा मा संताप्तम् इत्युपानहौ ।
text_mt: [He puts on] two shoes, with [the formula]: ‘You two divine deities are the support; do not torment me.’

sanskrit_iast: viṣṭambho 'sīti dhārayedvaiṇavīṃ yaṣṭim |
meaning: विष्टम्भो ऽसीति धारयेद्वैणवीं यष्टिम् ।
text_mt: He should hold a bamboo staff, with [the formula]: ‘You are the prop.’

sanskrit_iast: sodakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum |
meaning: सोदकं च कमण्डलुम् ।

sanskrit_iast: nityavratāny āhur ācāryāḥ |
meaning: नित्यव्रतान्य् आहुर् आचार्याः ।
text_mt: The teachers declare [these to be] permanent observances.

sanskrit_iast: dvivastro 'ta ūrdhvam | śobhanaṃ vāso bhartavyamiti śrutiḥ |
meaning: द्विवस्त्रो ऽत ऊर्ध्वम् । शोभनं वासो भर्तव्यमिति श्रुतिः ।
text_mt: From then on he wears two garments; / a handsome garment should be worn, so says the sacred tradition.

sanskrit_iast: āmantrya gurūn gurvadhīnāṃśca svān gṛhānvrajet |
meaning: आमन्त्र्य गुरून् गुर्वधीनांश्च स्वान् गृहान्व्रजेत् ।
text_mt: Taking leave of the teachers and those dependent on the teachers, he should go to his own home.

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣiddham aparayā dvārā niḥsaraṇaṃ malavadvāsasā saha sambhāṣā rajasvadvāsasā saha śayyā gor guror duruktavacanam asthāne śayanaṃ sthānaṃ smayanaṃ yānaṃ gānaṃ smaraṇamiti | tāni varjayet |
meaning: प्रतिषिद्धम् अपरया द्वारा निःसरणं मलवद्वाससा सह सम्भाषा रजस्वद्वाससा सह शय्या गोर् गुरोर् दुरुक्तवचनम् अस्थाने शयनं स्थानं स्मयनं यानं गानं स्मरणमिति । तानि वर्जयेत् ।
text_mt: It is forbidden to go out through the western door, to converse with [a woman] in stained garments, to lie with [a woman] in menstruous garments, harsh speech toward a cow or a teacher, lying down or standing in an unfit place, laughing, riding in a vehicle, singing, and recalling [sensual things]; / these he should avoid.

sanskrit_iast: yājanaṃ vṛttiḥ | uñchaṃ śilamayācitapratigrahaḥ sādhubhyo vā yācitam | asaṃsidhyamānāyāṃ vā vaiśyavṛttiḥ |
meaning: याजनं वृत्तिः । उञ्छं शिलमयाचितप्रतिग्रहः साधुभ्यो वा याचितम् । असंसिध्यमानायां वा वैश्यवृत्तिः ।
text_mt: His livelihood is sacrificing for others; / gleaning ears of corn, picking up grains, accepting unsolicited gifts, or begging from the virtuous; / or, if that does not succeed, the occupation of a Vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: svādhyāyavirodhino 'rthān utsṛjet |
meaning: स्वाध्यायविरोधिनो ऽर्थान् उत्सृजेत् ।
text_mt:
He should abandon matters that conflict with Vedic recitation.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 10 / Having subdued his anger and possessing joy, he should find a joyous wife who has not belonged to another before and is younger [than himself].

sanskrit_iast: vinītakrodhaḥ saharṣaḥ saharṣīṃ bhāryāṃ vindetānanyapūrvāṃ yavīyasīm |
meaning: विनीतक्रोधः सहर्षः सहर्षीं भार्यां विन्देतानन्यपूर्वां यवीयसीम् ।

sanskrit_iast: asamānapravarair vivāhaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ saptamāt pitṛbandhubhyaḥ pañcamān mātṛbandhubhyo bījinaśca |
meaning: असमानप्रवरैर् विवाहः । ऊर्ध्वं सप्तमात् पितृबन्धुभ्यः पञ्चमान् मातृबन्धुभ्यो बीजिनश्च ।
text_mt: Marriage is with those who do not have the same ancestral seers; / beyond the seventh degree from the father's relatives, and beyond the fifth from the mother's relatives, and [likewise] of the biological father.

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikāsvātipūrvair iti varayet |
meaning: कृत्तिकास्वातिपूर्वैर् इति वरयेत् ।
text_mt: He should woo under [the asterisms] Kṛttikā, Svāti, and the preceding ones.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgaśiraḥśraviṣṭhottarāṇīty upayamet |
meaning: मृगशिरःश्रविष्ठोत्तराणीत्य् उपयमेत् ।
text_mt: He should marry under Mṛgaśiras, Śraviṣṭhā, and the subsequent ones.

sanskrit_iast: pañca vivāhakārakāṇi bhavanti vittaṃ rūpaṃ vidyā prajñā bāndhavamiti |
meaning: पञ्च विवाहकारकाणि भवन्ति वित्तं रूपं विद्या प्रज्ञा बान्धवमिति ।
text_mt: There are five factors in marriage: wealth, beauty, learning, intelligence, and family connections.

sanskrit_iast: ekālābhe vittaṃ visṛjet | dvitīyālābhe rūpam | tṛtīyālābhe vidyām | prajñāyāṃ tu bāndhave ca vivadante |
meaning: एकालाभे वित्तं विसृजेत् । द्वितीयालाभे रूपम् । तृतीयालाभे विद्याम् । प्रज्ञायां तु बान्धवे च विवदन्ते ।
text_mt: If one is lacking, he may disregard wealth; / if a second is lacking, beauty; / if a third is lacking, learning; / but they disagree regarding intelligence and family connections.
