sanskrit_iast: anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthā yebhiḥ sakhāyo yantu no vareyam | samaryamā saṃ bhago no 'nunīyāt saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamastu devāḥ | iti varakān vrajato 'numantrayate |
meaning: अनृक्षरा ऋजवः सन्तु पन्था येभिः सखायो यन्तु नो वरेयम् । समर्यमा सं भगो नो ऽनुनीयात् सं जास्पत्यं सुयममस्तु देवाः । इति वरकान् व्रजतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: ‘Straight and thornless may the paths be by which our friends go to woo! / May Aryaman and Bhaga unite us! May the union of husband and wife be well-regulated, O gods!’ / With this [verse] he follows the wooers as they set out.

sanskrit_iast: bandhumatīṃ kanyām aspṛṣṭamaithunām upayacchetānagnikāṃ śreṣṭhām |
meaning: बन्धुमतीं कन्याम् अस्पृष्टमैथुनाम् उपयच्छेतानग्निकां श्रेष्ठाम् ।
text_mt: He should marry a maiden who has relatives, who has not been touched by sexual intercourse, who has reached puberty, and is excellent.

sanskrit_iast: vijñānamasyai kuryāt | caturo loṣṭān āharet sītāloṣṭaṃ vediloṣṭaṃ gomayaloṣṭaṃ śmaśānaloṣṭaṃ ca |
meaning: विज्ञानमस्यै कुर्यात् । चतुरो लोष्टान् आहरेत् सीतालोष्टं वेदिलोष्टं गोमयलोष्टं श्मशानलोष्टं च ।
text_mt: He should make an examination of her: / he should bring four clods of earth—a clod from a furrow, a clod from an altar, a clod from cowdung, and a clod from a cremation ground.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāmekaṃ gṛhṇīṣveti brūyāt | śmaśānaloṣṭaṃ ced gṛhṇīyān nopayaccheta |
meaning: तेषामेकं गृह्णीष्वेति ब्रूयात् । श्मशानलोष्टं चेद् गृह्णीयान् नोपयच्छेत ।
text_mt: He should say to her, ‘Take one of these.’ / If she takes the clod from the cremation ground, he should not marry her.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃspṛṣṭāṃ dharmeṇopayaccheta brāhmeṇa śaulkena vā |
meaning: असंस्पृष्टां धर्मेणोपयच्छेत ब्राह्मेण शौल्केन वा ।
text_mt: Untouched, he should marry her according to the rule: the Brāhma rite or through a bride-price.

sanskrit_iast: śatamitirathaṃ dadyād gomithunaṃ vā |
meaning: शतमितिरथं दद्याद् गोमिथुनं वा ।
text_mt: He should give a hundred [cows] and a chariot, or a pair of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayāṃs tejanīṣv āsej janyān kaumārikāṃś ca | pūrve janyāḥ syur apare kaumārikāḥ |
meaning: उभयांस् तेजनीष्व् आसेज् जन्यान् कौमारिकांश् च । पूर्वे जन्याः स्युर् अपरे कौमारिकाः ।
text_mt: He should seat both parties on mats of reeds: the wedding guests of the groom and the maiden's attendants; / the groom's guests should be to the east, the maiden's attendants to the west.

sanskrit_iast: caturo gomayapiṇḍān kṛtvā dvāv anyebhyas tathānyebhya iti prayacchet |
meaning: चतुरो गोमयपिण्डान् कृत्वा द्वाव् अन्येभ्यस् तथान्येभ्य इति प्रयच्छेत् ।
text_mt: Having made four lumps of cowdung, he should present two to the one group and likewise [two] to the other group.

sanskrit_iast: dhanaṃ na iti brūyuḥ | putrapaśavo na iti janyāḥ |
meaning: धनं न इति ब्रूयुः । पुत्रपशवो न इति जन्याः ।
text_mt: ‘Wealth for us!’ they should say; / ‘Sons and cattle for us!’ the groom's guests [should say].

sanskrit_iast: dadāni | pratigṛhṇānīti trir brahmadeyām |
meaning: ददानि । प्रतिगृह्णानीति त्रिर् ब्रह्मदेयाम् ।
text_mt: "I give," / "I accept"—thus three times for a maiden given according to the brahma rite.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtenāṃsena visaṃkaseyuḥ |
meaning: कृतेनांसेन विसंकसेयुः ।
text_mt: They should move apart with a portion [of the remnants] that has been prepared.

sanskrit_iast: trir ānandaṃ māgadho hvayet |
meaning: त्रिर् आनन्दं मागधो ह्वयेत् ।
text_mt:
A bard should summon joy three times.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 11
Six are worthy of the guest-offering: the officiating priest, the teacher, the bridegroom, the king, the one who has completed the ritual bath, and a dear guest.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍarghyārhā bhavanti ṛtvigācāryo vivāhyo rājā snātakaḥ priyaśceti |
meaning: षडर्घ्यार्हा भवन्ति ऋत्विगाचार्यो विवाह्यो राजा स्नातकः प्रियश्चेति ।

sanskrit_iast: aprākaraṇikānnā parisaṃvatsarād arhayanti | anyatra yājyāt karmaṇo vivāhāc ca |
meaning: अप्राकरणिकान्ना परिसंवत्सराद् अर्हयन्ति । अन्यत्र याज्यात् कर्मणो विवाहाच् च ।
text_mt: They offer the guest-offering to those not engaged in a ritual context once a year, / except for a sacrificial act and a marriage.

sanskrit_iast: na jīvapitṛko 'rghyaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt |
meaning: न जीवपितृको ऽर्घ्यं प्रतिगृह्णीयात् ।
text_mt: One whose father is living should not receive the guest-offering.

sanskrit_iast: athainam arhayanti |
meaning: अथैनम् अर्हयन्ति ।

sanskrit_iast: kāṃsye camase vā dadhani madhvāsicya varṣīyasāpidhāya virājo doho 'si virājo doho 'si virājo doham aśīya mayi dohaḥ padyāyai virāja iti madhuparkarmāhiyamāṇaṃ pratīkṣate |
meaning: कांस्ये चमसे वा दधनि मध्वासिच्य वर्षीयसापिधाय विराजो दोहो ऽसि विराजो दोहो ऽसि विराजो दोहम् अशीय मयि दोहः पद्यायै विराज इति मधुपर्कर्माहियमाणं प्रतीक्षते ।
text_mt: Having poured honey into curds in a bell-metal vessel or a cup, and having covered it with a larger one, he looks at the honey-mixture being brought forward with: "You are the milk of the Virāj, you are the milk of the Virāj; may I obtain the milk of the Virāj; in me is the milk for the four-footed Virāj."

sanskrit_iast: sāvitreṇa viṣṭarau pratigṛhya rāṣṭrabhṛd asīty āsaṃdyām udagagram āstṛṇāti |
meaning: सावित्रेण विष्टरौ प्रतिगृह्य राष्ट्रभृद् असीत्य् आसंद्याम् उदगग्रम् आस्तृणाति ।
text_mt: Having received the two grass cushions with the Sāvitrī verse, he spreads one with points directed toward the north on the stool with: "You are the realm-sustaining formula."

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ varṣma sadṛśānām udyatānām iva sūryaḥ | idam ahaṃ tam adharaṃ karomi yo mā kaścābhidāsati | ity ekasminn upaviśati |
meaning: अहं वर्ष्म सदृशानाम् उद्यतानाम् इव सूर्यः । इदम् अहं तम् अधरं करोमि यो मा कश्चाभिदासति । इत्य् एकस्मिन्न् उपविशति ।
text_mt: "I am the summit of my equals, like the sun rising. / Here I make him lower, whoever assails me" / —with this he sits down on one.

sanskrit_iast: mā tvadyoṣam ity anyataram adhastāt pādayor upakarṣati |
meaning: मा त्वद्योषम् इत्य् अन्यतरम् अधस्तात् पादयोर् उपकर्षति ।
text_mt: He draws the other under his feet with: "May I not part from you."

sanskrit_iast: viṣṭara āsīnāyaikaikaṃ triḥ prāha |
meaning: विष्टर आसीनायैकैकं त्रिः प्राह ।
text_mt: To him seated on the cushion, he announces each [article] three times.

sanskrit_iast: naiva bho ityāha | na mā riṣāmeti |
meaning: नैव भो इत्याह । न मा रिषामेति ।
text_mt: He says: "Surely not, sir," / [and]: "May we not suffer injury."

sanskrit_iast: ācamanīyāḥ prathamāḥ pratipadyante |
meaning: आचमनीयाः प्रथमाः प्रतिपद्यन्ते ।
text_mt: The waters for sipping are brought forward first.

sanskrit_iast: amṛtopastaraṇam asīty ācāmati |
meaning: अमृतोपस्तरणम् असीत्य् आचामति ।
text_mt: He sips water with: "You are the under-spreading of immortality."

sanskrit_iast: padyena pādau prakṣālayati |
meaning: पद्येन पादौ प्रक्षालयति ।
text_mt: He washes his feet with the foot-washing water.

sanskrit_iast: spṛśaty argham |
meaning: स्पृशत्य् अर्घम् ।

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ praṇayati |
meaning: ततः प्रणयति ।

sanskrit_iast: sāvitreṇobhayato viṣṭaraṃ madhuparkaṃ pratigṛhya adityās tvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmīti bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpyāvasāyya suparṇasya tvā garutmataś cakṣuṣāvekṣa ityavekṣya namo rudrāya pātrasada iti prādeśena pratidiśaṃ vyuddiśyāṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā ca madhu vātā ṛtāyata iti tisṛbhiḥ saṃsṛjati |
meaning: सावित्रेणोभयतो विष्टरं मधुपर्कं प्रतिगृह्य अदित्यास् त्वा पृष्ठे सादयामीति भूमौ प्रतिष्ठाप्यावसाय्य सुपर्णस्य त्वा गरुत्मतश् चक्षुषावेक्ष इत्यवेक्ष्य नमो रुद्राय पात्रसद इति प्रादेशेन प्रतिदिशं व्युद्दिश्याङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया च मधु वाता ऋतायत इति तिसृभिः संसृजति ।
text_mt: Having received the honey-mixture accompanied on both sides by a grass cushion with the Sāvitrī verse, having placed it on the ground with: "I set you on the back of Aditi," having brought it down, having looked at it with: "I look at you with the eye of the well-winged Garutmat," having pointed toward each direction with his span with: "Homage to Rudra, the dweller in the vessel," he mixes it with his thumb and fourth finger with the three verses beginning: "The winds blow sweets to the righteous."

sanskrit_iast: satyaṃ yaśaḥ śrīḥ śrayatāmiti triḥ prāśnāti bhūyiṣṭham |
meaning: सत्यं यशः श्रीः श्रयतामिति त्रिः प्राश्नाति भूयिष्ठम् ।
text_mt: He eats the largest portion three times with: "May truth, renown, and fortune resort [to me]."

sanskrit_iast: suhṛde 'vaśiṣṭaṃ prayacchati |
meaning: सुहृदे ऽवशिष्टं प्रयच्छति ।
text_mt: He gives the remainder to a friend.

sanskrit_iast: amṛtapidhānam asīty ācāmati |
meaning: अमृतपिधानम् असीत्य् आचामति ।
text_mt: He sips water with: "You are the covering of immortality."

sanskrit_iast: asiviṣṭarapāṇir gāṃ prāha |
meaning: असिविष्टरपाणिर् गां प्राह ।
text_mt: Holding a knife and a grass cushion in hand, he announces the cow.

sanskrit_iast: hato me pāpmā pāpmānaṃ me hata | yāṃ tvā devā vasavo 'nvajīviṣur ādityānāṃ svasāraṃ rudramātaram | daivīṃ gāmaditiṃ janānām ārabhantām arhatām arhaṇāya | oṃ kuruteti sampreṣyati |
meaning: हतो मे पाप्मा पाप्मानं मे हत । यां त्वा देवा वसवो ऽन्वजीविषुर् आदित्यानां स्वसारं रुद्रमातरम् । दैवीं गामदितिं जनानाम् आरभन्ताम् अर्हताम् अर्हणाय । ओं कुरुतेति सम्प्रेष्यति ।
text_mt: "Destroyed is my evil; destroy you my evil! / You upon whom the divine Vasus have lived, the sister of the Ādityas, the mother of the Rudras, / the divine cow, the Aditi of men—let them take hold of her for the honoring of the worthy guests! / Om! Do it!"—thus he commands.

sanskrit_iast: catur avarān brāhmaṇān nānāgotrān ityekaikaṃ paśvaṅgaṃ pāyasaṃ vā bhojayet |
meaning: चतुर् अवरान् ब्राह्मणान् नानागोत्रान् इत्येकैकं पश्वङ्गं पायसं वा भोजयेत् ।
text_mt: He should feed at least four brāhmaṇas of different clans, each one limb of the victim or milk-rice porridge.

sanskrit_iast: yadyutsṛjet mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa |
meaning: यद्युत्सृजेत् माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाम् अमृतस्य नाभिः । प्र नु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट ।
text_mt: If he lets [the cow] loose: "The mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of the Ādityas, the navel of immortality; / I proclaim now to the discerning person: do not kill the cow, the sinless Aditi!"

sanskrit_iast: om utsṛjata tṛṇānyat tūdakaṃ pibatu |
meaning: ओम् उत्सृजत तृणान्यत् तूदकं पिबतु ।
text_mt: "Om, set her loose! Let her eat grass; let her drink water."

sanskrit_iast: ityukte paśum ālabhante |
meaning: इत्युक्ते पशुम् आलभन्ते ।
text_mt: When this has been said, they slaughter an animal.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃ no mitra iti pāṇī prakṣālya yathārtham |
meaning: शं नो मित्र इति पाणी प्रक्षाल्य यथार्थम् ।
text_mt:
Having washed his hands with: "May Mitra be auspicious to us," [each proceeds] as needed.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 13
Then the adorning: "You are ornament; may I be sufficient for everything."

sanskrit_iast: athālaṃkaraṇam alaṃkaraṇam asi sarvasmā alaṃ bhūyāsam |
meaning: अथालंकरणम् अलंकरणम् असि सर्वस्मा अलं भूयासम् ।

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāpānau me tarpayāmi samānavyānau me tarpayāmy udānarūpe me tarpayāmi cakṣuḥśrotre me tarpayāmi sucakṣā aham akṣibhyāṃ bhūyāsaṃ suvarcā mukhena suśrutkarṇābhyām iti gandhācchādane |
meaning: प्राणापानौ मे तर्पयामि समानव्यानौ मे तर्पयाम्य् उदानरूपे मे तर्पयामि चक्षुःश्रोत्रे मे तर्पयामि सुचक्षा अहम् अक्षिभ्यां भूयासं सुवर्चा मुखेन सुश्रुत्कर्णाभ्याम् इति गन्धाच्छादने ।
text_mt: "I gratify my out-breath and in-breath; I gratify my equalizing breath and diffused breath; I gratify my ascending breath and form; I gratify my eye and ear; may I be good-eyed with my eyes, well-splendored in my face, and good-hearing with my ears"—with this [he applies] the ointment and garment.

sanskrit_iast: paridhāsye yaśo dhāsye dīrghāyutvāya jaradaṣṭir asmi | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīrvasūni cāyyo vibhajāya jīyām | ityahataṃ vāsa ācchādyāgniṃ prajvālya vyāhṛtibhir vrīhiyavān hutvā maṅgalāny āśāset |
meaning: परिधास्ये यशो धास्ये दीर्घायुत्वाय जरदष्टिर् अस्मि । शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूचीर्वसूनि चाय्यो विभजाय जीयाम् । इत्यहतं वास आच्छाद्याग्निं प्रज्वाल्य व्याहृतिभिर् व्रीहियवान् हुत्वा मङ्गलान्य् आशासेत् ।
text_mt: "I will put on, I will establish renown; for long life, I am one who attains old age. / And live a hundred full autumns; may I live to distribute valuable goods, being respected" / —having put on an unwashed garment with this verse, having kindled the fire, and having offered rice and barley with the mystic utterances, he should pray for auspicious things.

sanskrit_iast: atha pravadane kanyāmupavasitāṃ snātāṃ saśiraskām ahatenācchinnadaśena vāsasā saṃvītāṃ saṃstīrṇasya purastād vihitāni vāditrāṇi vidhivadupakalpya purastāt sviṣṭakṛto vāce pathyāyai pūṣṇe pṛthivyā agnaye senāyai dhenāyai gāyatryai triṣṭubhe jagatyā anuṣṭubhe paṅktaye virāje rākāyai sinīvālyai kuhvai tvaṣṭra āśāyai sampattyai bhūtyai nirṛtyā anumatyai parjanyāyāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte ca juhuyāt |
meaning: अथ प्रवदने कन्यामुपवसितां स्नातां सशिरस्काम् अहतेनाच्छिन्नदशेन वाससा संवीतां संस्तीर्णस्य पुरस्ताद् विहितानि वादित्राणि विधिवदुपकल्प्य पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतो वाचे पथ्यायै पूष्णे पृथिव्या अग्नये सेनायै धेनायै गायत्र्यै त्रिष्टुभे जगत्या अनुष्टुभे पङ्क्तये विराजे राकायै सिनीवाल्यै कुह्वै त्वष्ट्र आशायै सम्पत्त्यै भूत्यै निरृत्या अनुमत्यै पर्जन्यायाग्नये स्विष्टकृते च जुहुयात् ।
text_mt:
Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 13
Then, at the musical recital, when the maiden has fasted, bathed, including her head, and is clothed in an unwashed garment whose fringes are uncut, having prepared the prescribed musical instruments in front of the strewn grass according to rule, he should make oblations before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering to Vāc Pathyā, Pūṣan, the Earth, Agni, Senā, Dhenā, Gāyatrī, Triṣṭubh, Jagatī, Anuṣṭubh, Paṅkti, Virāj, Rākā, Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Tvaṣṭṛ, Āśā, Sampatti, Bhūti, Nirṛti, Anumati, Parjanya, and Agni Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaśeṣeṇa pāṇī pralipya kanyāyā mukhaṃ saṃmārṣṭi priyāṃ karomi pataye devarāṇāṃ śvaśurāya ca | rucyai tvāgniḥ saṃsṛjatu ruciṣyā pataye bhava | saubhāgyena tvā saṃsṛjatv ilā devī ghṛtapadīndrāṇy agnāyyaśvinī rāṭ | vāgilā dyaur arundhatī | iti ca |
meaning: आज्यशेषेण पाणी प्रलिप्य कन्याया मुखं संमार्ष्टि प्रियां करोमि पतये देवराणां श्वशुराय च । रुच्यै त्वाग्निः संसृजतु रुचिष्या पतये भव । सौभाग्येन त्वा संसृजत्व् इला देवी घृतपदीन्द्राण्य् अग्नाय्यश्विनी राट् । वागिला द्यौर् अरुन्धती । इति च ।
text_mt: Having smeared his hands with the remainder of the clarified butter, he strokes the face of the maiden with: "I make [you] dear to your husband, to your brothers-in-law, and to your father-in-law. / May Agni unite you with charm; be full of charm for your husband. / May Goddess Ilā of butter-steps unite you with good fortune, and Indrāṇī, Agnāyī, the Queen of the Aśvins; / Vāc, Ilā, Dyaus, Arundhatī."

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi vāditrāṇy abhimantrayate yā caturdhā pravadaty agnau yā vāte yā bṛhatyuta | paśūnāṃ yāṃ brāhmaṇe nyadadhuḥ śivā sā pravadatv iha | iti |
meaning: सर्वाणि वादित्राण्य् अभिमन्त्रयते या चतुर्धा प्रवदत्य् अग्नौ या वाते या बृहत्युत । पशूनां यां ब्राह्मणे न्यदधुः शिवा सा प्रवदत्व् इह । इति ।
text_mt: He consecrates all the musical instruments with: "She who sounds fourfold in the fire, who in the wind, and who in the high heaven; / whom they placed in the brāhmaṇa among animals—may she, auspicious, sound here!"

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi vāditrāṇy alaṃkṛtya kanyā pravādayate śubhaṃ vada dundubhe suprajāstvāya gomukha | prakrīḍantu kanyāḥ sumanasyamānāḥ sahendrāṇyā savayasaḥ sanīḍāḥ | prajāpatiryo vasati prajāsu prajās tanvate sumanasyamānāḥ | sa imāḥ prajā ramayatu prajātyai svayaṃ ca no ramatāṃ śaṃ dadhānaḥ | iti |
meaning: सर्वाणि वादित्राण्य् अलंकृत्य कन्या प्रवादयते शुभं वद दुन्दुभे सुप्रजास्त्वाय गोमुख । प्रक्रीडन्तु कन्याः सुमनस्यमानाः सहेन्द्राण्या सवयसः सनीडाः । प्रजापतिर्यो वसति प्रजासु प्रजास् तन्वते सुमनस्यमानाः । स इमाः प्रजा रमयतु प्रजात्यै स्वयं च नो रमतां शं दधानः । इति ।
text_mt: Having adorned all the musical instruments, the maiden causes them to be played with: "Speak auspiciously, O drum; O gomukha horn, for abundant offspring! / Let the maidens play, well-disposed, together with Indrāṇī, of like age, sharing a home. / Prajāpati who dwells among creatures—creatures produce, well-disposed. / May he cause these creatures to rejoice for procreation, and may he himself, bringing peace, rejoice with us!"

sanskrit_iast: pravadanti kārālikāni |
meaning: प्रवदन्ति कारालिकानि ।
text_mt: The kārālikā instruments sound.

sanskrit_iast: kanyām udakenābhiṣiñcet |
meaning: कन्याम् उदकेनाभिषिञ्चेत् ।
text_mt:
He should sprinkle the maiden with water.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 14
"In the hole of the chariot, in the hole of the cart, in the hole of the yoke of the Hundred-Powered One, / Indra made the maiden three times full, having the luster of the sun" / —with this he gives her an unwashed garment.

sanskrit_iast: khe rathasya khe 'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakratoḥ | abālām indrastriḥ pūrtty akṛṇot sūryavarcasaḥ | ityathāsyā ahataṃ vāsaḥ prayacchati |
meaning: खे रथस्य खे ऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतोः । अबालाम् इन्द्रस्त्रिः पूर्त्त्य् अकृणोत् सूर्यवर्चसः । इत्यथास्या अहतं वासः प्रयच्छति ।

sanskrit_iast: athaināṃ darbhaśulvena saṃnahyati saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ saṃ tvā nahyāmy adbhiroṣadhībhiḥ | saṃ tvā nahyāmi prajayā dhanena saha saṃnaddhā sunuhi bhāgadheyam | iti |
meaning: अथैनां दर्भशुल्वेन संनह्यति सं त्वा नह्यामि पयसा पृथिव्याः सं त्वा नह्याम्य् अद्भिरोषधीभिः । सं त्वा नह्यामि प्रजया धनेन सह संनद्धा सुनुहि भागधेयम् । इति ।
text_mt: Then he girds her with a rope of darbha grass: "I gird you with the milk of the earth; I gird you with waters and plants. / I gird you with offspring and with wealth; thus girded, generate a portion [for yourself]!"

sanskrit_iast: athaināṃ vāsaso 'ntaṃ grāhayitvābhyudānayati aghoracakṣur apatighny edhi | ehi śivā paśubhyaḥ sumanāḥ suvarcāḥ | dīrghāyupatnī prajayā svarvid indrapraṇayīr upa no vastum ehi | iti |
meaning: अथैनां वाससो ऽन्तं ग्राहयित्वाभ्युदानयति अघोरचक्षुर् अपतिघ्न्य् एधि । एहि शिवा पशुभ्यः सुमनाः सुवर्चाः । दीर्घायुपत्नी प्रजया स्वर्विद् इन्द्रप्रणयीर् उप नो वस्तुम् एहि । इति ।
text_mt: Then, having made her grasp the edge of the garment, he leads her forward: "Be not of terrible eye, not a slayer of your husband; / come, auspicious to cattle, well-disposed, full of splendor. / Wife of a long-lived one, finding heaven through offspring, favored by Indra, come to dwell beside us!"

sanskrit_iast: samūhanollepanoddhananāvekṣaṇam ity agnikāle bhūmisaṃskārān sarvatra yathānimittam |
meaning: समूहनोल्लेपनोद्धननावेक्षणम् इत्य् अग्निकाले भूमिसंस्कारान् सर्वत्र यथानिमित्तम् ।
text_mt: At the time of the fire, the preparation of the ground consists of sweeping, smearing, digging up, and sprinkling, everywhere according to occasion.

sanskrit_iast: paścādagneḥ kaṭe tejanyāṃ vā darbheṣv āsanam |
meaning: पश्चादग्नेः कटे तेजन्यां वा दर्भेष्व् आसनम् ।
text_mt: Behind the fire is the seat, on a mat, or on a woven reed mat, or on darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast: śucau bhūmipradeśe śamīśamakaśyāmākānāṃ priyaṅgudūrvāgaurasarṣapāṇāṃ yathālābhagandhasakṣīraphalavadbhyo vanaspatibhyo haritparṇakuśayavādibhiś cānnair yā oṣadhayaḥ | samanyā yantīty anuvākena śaṃ no devīriti ca sahiraṇyāpo 'bhimantrya praṇītodakumbhaṃ praṇayet |
meaning: शुचौ भूमिप्रदेशे शमीशमकश्यामाकानां प्रियङ्गुदूर्वागौरसर्षपाणां यथालाभगन्धसक्षीरफलवद्भ्यो वनस्पतिभ्यो हरित्पर्णकुशयवादिभिश् चान्नैर् या ओषधयः । समन्या यन्तीत्य् अनुवाकेन शं नो देवीरिति च सहिरण्यापो ऽभिमन्त्र्य प्रणीतोदकुम्भं प्रणयेत् ।
text_mt: On a pure spot of ground, with śamī, śamaka, śyāmāka, priyaṅgu, dūrvā, and white mustard, with whatever available fragrant, milky, and fruit-bearing trees, and with green leaves, kuśa grass, barley, and other food grains, having consecrated the water containing gold with the recitation section beginning: "The herbs that are...", and with: "May the divine waters be for our peace...", he should bring forward a water-jar of holy water.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ lājāhutīṣu hūyamānāsu bhrātā brahmacārī vodgṛhya dhārayed dakṣiṇataśca |
meaning: तं लाजाहुतीषु हूयमानासु भ्राता ब्रह्मचारी वोद्गृह्य धारयेद् दक्षिणतश्च ।
text_mt: While the parched-grain offerings are being offered, a brother or a Vedic student, lifting it up, should hold it, and from the south.

sanskrit_iast: lājān saṃskṛtān śamīparṇamiśrān śūrpeṇa dakṣiṇato mātānyā vāvidhavā |
meaning: लाजान् संस्कृतान् शमीपर्णमिश्रान् शूर्पेण दक्षिणतो मातान्या वाविधवा ।
text_mt: On the south, the mother or another non-widowed woman holds prepared fried grain mixed with śamī leaves in a winnowing basket.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya brahmāṇam āmantrya samidham ādhāyāghārāv āghāryājyabhāgau hutvā |
meaning: आज्यं संस्कृत्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य समिधम् आधायाघाराव् आघार्याज्यभागौ हुत्वा ।
text_mt: Having prepared the clarified butter, invited the Brahman priest, placed the kindling stick, poured the two libations of clarified butter, and offered the two portions of clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast: atha juhoti | agnaye janavide svāhā | somāya janavide svāhā | gandharvāya janavide svāhā | somaḥ prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttaraḥ | tṛtīyo 'gniṣṭe patisturyo 'haṃ manuṣyajāḥ | svāhā | somo 'dadad gandharvāya gandharvo 'dadad agnaye | rayiṃ ca putrāṃś cādād agnir mahyamatho imām | iti |
meaning: अथ जुहोति । अग्नये जनविदे स्वाहा । सोमाय जनविदे स्वाहा । गन्धर्वाय जनविदे स्वाहा । सोमः प्रथमो विविदे गन्धर्वो विविद उत्तरः । तृतीयो ऽग्निष्टे पतिस्तुर्यो ऽहं मनुष्यजाः । स्वाहा । सोमो ऽददद् गन्धर्वाय गन्धर्वो ऽददद् अग्नये । रयिं च पुत्रांश् चादाद् अग्निर् मह्यमथो इमाम् । इति ।
text_mt: he then makes the offerings: / 'To Agni, finder of people, svāhā! / To Soma, finder of people, svāhā! / To the Gandharva, finder of people, svāhā! / Soma obtained [you] first, the Gandharva obtained [you] next, / Agni was your third husband; I, born of human beings, am the fourth, / svāhā! / Soma gave [her] to the Gandharva, the Gandharva gave [her] to Agni; / Agni has given wealth, sons, and moreover her to me,' / so saying.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭābhiḥ pratyṛcam ājyāhutīr juhuyāt |
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भ इत्यष्टाभिः प्रत्यृचम् आज्याहुतीर् जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: He should offer offerings of clarified butter with the eight [verses beginning with] 'The Golden Germ', verse by verse.

sanskrit_iast: yena karmaṇertset tatra jayāñ juhuyāditi jayānāṃ śrutiḥ | tvā yathoktam | ākūtyai tvā svāhā | bhūtyai tvā svāhā | kāmāyai tvā svāhā | rakṣāyai tvā svāhā | samṛdhe tvā svāhā | samṛddhyai tvā svāhā | ṛcā stomam | prajāpataye | bhūḥ svāhā | ayāś cāgne 'sīti ca |
meaning: येन कर्मणेर्त्सेत् तत्र जयाञ् जुहुयादिति जयानां श्रुतिः । त्वा यथोक्तम् । आकूत्यै त्वा स्वाहा । भूत्यै त्वा स्वाहा । कामायै त्वा स्वाहा । रक्षायै त्वा स्वाहा । समृधे त्वा स्वाहा । समृद्ध्यै त्वा स्वाहा । ऋचा स्तोमम् । प्रजापतये । भूः स्वाहा । अयाश् चाग्ने ऽसीति च ।
text_mt: There is a scriptural passage regarding the Jaya offerings: 'In whatever rite one desires to prosper, therein one should offer the Jaya offerings.' / '[To] you...' as prescribed: / 'To Intention, you, svāhā! / To Prosperity, you, svāhā! / To Desire, you, svāhā! / To Protection, you, svāhā! / To Thriving, you, svāhā! / To Success, you, svāhā! / [Through] the verse the praise-song...' / 'To Prajāpati...' / 'Bhūḥ, svāhā!' / and 'Agni, you are unbending...'

sanskrit_iast: uttarato 'gner darbheṣu prācīṃ kanyām avasthāpya purastāt pratyaṅmukha upayantā devasya te savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāmy aham asāv ity athāsyā upanayanavaddhastaṃ gṛhṇāti nīcāriktam ariktena | gṛhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭir yathāsat | bhago 'ryamā savitā puraṃdhir mahyaṃ tvādurgāharpatyāya devāḥ | ūrdhvā vāk samabhavat purā devāsurebhyaḥ | yāṃ tvā viśvasya bhūtasya prāg āyāmy asyā agrataḥ | sarasvati predam ava subhage vājinīvati | yena bhūtaṃ samabhavad yena viśvamidaṃ jagat tāmadya gāthāṃ gāsyāmo yā strīṇām uttamaṃ manaḥ | sā tvam asy amo 'ham amo 'hamasmi sā tvam | dyaur ahaṃ pṛthivī tvaṃ bṛhad ahaṃ rathaṃtaraṃ tvam | reto 'ham asmi retodhṛk tvam | sāmāham asmi ṛktvaṃ mano 'hamasmi vāktvam | sā mām anuvratā bhava sā mām anuprajāyasva | prajāṃ sṛjāvahā ubhau puṃse putrāya kartave | śriyai putrāya vethaveha sūnṛte | iti |
meaning: उत्तरतो ऽग्नेर् दर्भेषु प्राचीं कन्याम् अवस्थाप्य पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुख उपयन्ता देवस्य ते सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां हस्तं गृह्णाम्य् अहम् असाव् इत्य् अथास्या उपनयनवद्धस्तं गृह्णाति नीचारिक्तम् अरिक्तेन । गृह्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तं मया पत्या जरदष्टिर् यथासत् । भगो ऽर्यमा सविता पुरंधिर् मह्यं त्वादुर्गाहर्पत्याय देवाः । ऊर्ध्वा वाक् समभवत् पुरा देवासुरेभ्यः । यां त्वा विश्वस्य भूतस्य प्राग् आयाम्य् अस्या अग्रतः । सरस्वति प्रेदम् अव सुभगे वाजिनीवति । येन भूतं समभवद् येन विश्वमिदं जगत् तामद्य गाथां गास्यामो या स्त्रीणाम् उत्तमं मनः । सा त्वम् अस्य् अमो ऽहम् अमो ऽहमस्मि सा त्वम् । द्यौर् अहं पृथिवी त्वं बृहद् अहं रथंतरं त्वम् । रेतो ऽहम् अस्मि रेतोधृक् त्वम् । सामाहम् अस्मि ऋक्त्वं मनो ऽहमस्मि वाक्त्वम् । सा माम् अनुव्रता भव सा माम् अनुप्रजायस्व । प्रजां सृजावहा उभौ पुंसे पुत्राय कर्तवे । श्रियै पुत्राय वेथवेह सूनृते । इति ।
text_mt: Having made the girl stand on darbha grass north of the fire, facing east, the bridegroom, facing west in front of her, saying: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take the hand of you, such-and-such,' then takes her hand as in the initiation of a Vedic student, her hand turned downward and empty, with his own hand not empty: / 'I take your hand for good fortune, so that with me as your husband you may reach old age. / Bhaga, Aryaman, Savitṛ, Puraṃdhi—the gods have given you to me for householdership. / Upright speech arose before the gods and demons. / You whom I, of every being, lead eastward in front of her— / O Sarasvatī, favor this, auspicious and rich in mares! / By which the past arose, by which this whole world [came to be], we shall sing that song today, which is the highest mind of women. / You are she, I am he; I am he, you are she. / I am heaven, you are earth; I am the Bṛhat [sāman], you are the Rathaṃtara [sāman]. / I am the seed, you are the holder of seed. / I am the melody, you are the verse; I am the mind, you are the speech. / Follow my vow; bear offspring following me. / Let us both generate offspring, to bring forth a male son; / toward prosperity, toward a son, run here, O truth-speaking one,' / so saying.

sanskrit_iast: pradakṣiṇamagniṃ pariṇayet |
meaning: प्रदक्षिणमग्निं परिणयेत् ।
text_mt: He should lead her clockwise around the fire.

sanskrit_iast: paścād agner darbheṣvaśmānamavasthāpayati ātiṣṭhemam aśmānamaśmeva tvaṃ sthirā bhava | kṛṇvantu viśve devā āyuṣṭe śaradaḥ śatam | iti |
meaning: पश्चाद् अग्नेर् दर्भेष्वश्मानमवस्थापयति आतिष्ठेमम् अश्मानमश्मेव त्वं स्थिरा भव । कृण्वन्तु विश्वे देवा आयुष्टे शरदः शतम् । इति ।
text_mt: Behind the fire, he places a stone upon the darbha grass: / 'Tread upon this stone; be firm like a stone. / May all the gods make your life a hundred autumns,' / so saying.

sanskrit_iast: atraivāsyā dvitīyaṃ vāsaḥ prayacchati |
meaning: अत्रैवास्या द्वितीयं वासः प्रयच्छति ।
text_mt: Right here he gives her the second garment.

sanskrit_iast: uparyagnāv añjalau lājān bhrātā brahmacārī vopastīrṇa āvapet |
meaning: उपर्यग्नाव् अञ्जलौ लाजान् भ्राता ब्रह्मचारी वोपस्तीर्ण आवपेत् ।
text_mt: Her brother or a Vedic student should pour fried grain into her cupped hands spread over the fire, upon which an underlayer [of clarified butter] has been spread.

sanskrit_iast: tān abhighāritān avicchindatī juhuyāt | kartānumantrayeta | iyaṃ nāry upabrūte lājān āvapantikā | dīrghāyurastu me patir edhantāṃ jñātayo mama | aryamaṇaṃ nu devaṃ kanyāgnim ayakṣata | so 'smāndevo 'ryamā preto muñcātu māmuta | svāhā | iti |
meaning: तान् अभिघारितान् अविच्छिन्दती जुहुयात् । कर्तानुमन्त्रयेत । इयं नार्य् उपब्रूते लाजान् आवपन्तिका । दीर्घायुरस्तु मे पतिर् एधन्तां ज्ञातयो मम । अर्यमणं नु देवं कन्याग्निम् अयक्षत । सो ऽस्मान्देवो ऽर्यमा प्रेतो मुञ्चातु मामुत । स्वाहा । इति ।
text_mt: She should offer them, dripped over [with clarified butter], without breaking [the stream]. / The performer should recite after her: / 'This woman speaks, pouring the fried grain: / "May my husband be long-lived; may my kinsmen flourish." / The girl has now sacrificed to god Aryaman, to Agni. / May that god Aryaman release us from here, not from yonder, / svāhā!' / so saying.

sanskrit_iast: vīrasūr jīvapatnīr bhūyāsam iti sarvatra vācayet |
meaning: वीरसूर् जीवपत्नीर् भूयासम् इति सर्वत्र वाचयेत् ।
text_mt: At every [turn] he should make her say: 'May I be a mother of heroes, whose husband is living.'

sanskrit_iast: tubhyamagre paryaṇayaṃ sūryāṃ vahatunā saha | punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha | iti dvitīyaṃ pariṇayet |
meaning: तुभ्यमग्रे पर्यणयं सूर्यां वहतुना सह । पुनः पतिभ्यो जायां दा अग्ने प्रजया सह । इति द्वितीयं परिणयेत् ।
text_mt: 'To you they first led Sūryā around together with the bridal procession; / give the wife back to the husbands, O Agni, together with offspring,' / with this he should lead her around the second time.

sanskrit_iast: evameva tṛtīyam | avasthāpanaprabhṛti samānam | pūṣaṇaṃ nu devam | varuṇaṃ nu devamiti homau | kanyāgnim ayakṣateti samānam |
meaning: एवमेव तृतीयम् । अवस्थापनप्रभृति समानम् । पूषणं नु देवम् । वरुणं नु देवमिति होमौ । कन्याग्निम् अयक्षतेति समानम् ।
text_mt: In this very way, the third time. / Beginning from the placing [on the stone], it is the same. / 'To god Pūṣan now...', / 'To god Varuṇa now...', these are the two offerings. / 'The girl has sacrificed to Agni...' is the same.

sanskrit_iast: kāmena caturthī pūrayitvā dvir abhighāryottarārdhapūrvārdhe juhuyāt |
meaning: कामेन चतुर्थी पूरयित्वा द्विर् अभिघार्योत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: Having filled [her cupped hands] at will the fourth time and dripped clarified butter twice over it, she should offer in the northern half of the eastern half.

sanskrit_iast: athaināṃ prācīṃ sapta padāni prakramayati ekam iṣe viṣṇustvāṃ nayatu | dve ūrje | trīṇi rāyaspoṣāya | catvāri māyobhavāya | pañca prajābhyaḥ | ṣaḍ ṛtubhyaḥ | sapta saptabhyo hotrābhyaḥ | viṣṇus tvāṃ nayatv iti dvitīyaprabhṛtyanuṣajet | sakhī saptapadī bhava sakhyaṃ te gameyaṃ sakhyātte mā riṣam iti saptama enāṃ prekṣamāṇāṃ samīkṣate |
meaning: अथैनां प्राचीं सप्त पदानि प्रक्रमयति एकम् इषे विष्णुस्त्वां नयतु । द्वे ऊर्जे । त्रीणि रायस्पोषाय । चत्वारि मायोभवाय । पञ्च प्रजाभ्यः । षड् ऋतुभ्यः । सप्त सप्तभ्यो होत्राभ्यः । विष्णुस् त्वां नयत्व् इति द्वितीयप्रभृत्यनुषजेत् । सखी सप्तपदी भव सख्यं ते गमेयं सख्यात्ते मा रिषम् इति सप्तम एनां प्रेक्षमाणां समीक्षते ।
text_mt: Then he makes her take seven steps toward the east: / 'One for food may Viṣṇu lead you. / Two for strength... / Three for the increase of wealth... / Four for comfort... / Five for offspring... / Six for the seasons... / Seven for the seven hotṛ-offices...' / From the second onward, he should append: 'May Viṣṇu lead you.' / With: 'Be a friend, having taken seven steps; may I enter into your friendship; may I not fall away from your friendship,' at the seventh [step] he looks closely at her as she looks at him.

sanskrit_iast: pra tvā muñcātu varuṇasya pāśād yena tvābadhnāt savitā suśevaḥ | dhātuśca yonau sukṛtasya loke hṛṣṭā saṃ saha patyā bhūyāsam | iti śulvaṃ visraṃsyodakumbhena mārjayante punantu mā pitara ityanuvākena | āpohiṣṭhīyenety eke |
meaning: प्र त्वा मुञ्चातु वरुणस्य पाशाद् येन त्वाबध्नात् सविता सुशेवः । धातुश्च योनौ सुकृतस्य लोके हृष्टा सं सह पत्या भूयासम् । इति शुल्वं विस्रंस्योदकुम्भेन मार्जयन्ते पुनन्तु मा पितर इत्यनुवाकेन । आपोहिष्ठीयेनेत्य् एके ।
text_mt: 'I release you from the fetter of Varuṇa, with which the kindly Savitṛ bound you. / In the womb of the creator, in the world of good deeds, may I be joyful together with my husband,' / reciting this, having loosened the cord, they sprinkle [themselves] with a water jar with the recitation section 'May the fathers purify me...'; / with the hymn beginning with 'Waters indeed are...', according to some.

sanskrit_iast: sumaṅgalīr iyaṃ vadhur imāṃ sametya paśyata | saubhāgyamasyai dattvā yathārthaṃ viparetana | iti |
meaning: सुमङ्गलीर् इयं वधुर् इमां समेत्य पश्यत । सौभाग्यमस्यै दत्त्वा यथार्थं विपरेतन । इति ।
text_mt: 'This bride is very auspicious; come together and look at her. / Having bestowed good fortune upon her, disperse according to your destination,' / so saying.

sanskrit_iast: sthālīpākena śeṣo vyākhyātaḥ |
meaning: स्थालीपाकेन शेषो व्याख्यातः ।
text_mt: The remainder is explained by the pot-cooked offering.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthaktvet | yena dyaur ugrety evaṃprabhṛtaya udvāhe homāḥ syuḥ | nāpāṇigrahaṇe lājāḥ | samānaṃ prakramaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ ca |
meaning: पृथक्त्वेत् । येन द्यौर् उग्रेत्य् एवंप्रभृतय उद्वाहे होमाः स्युः । नापाणिग्रहणे लाजाः । समानं प्रक्रमणं मार्जनं च ।
text_mt:
In case of separation [of the rites]: / the offerings in the wedding should be those beginning with 'By whom the heaven is fierce...'; / there is no fried grain in the taking of the hand; / the stepping and the sprinkling are the same.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 15 / 'The two curved parts, the two recesses around the chariot, the obscured winds that sweep toward the front, / the far-hurling weapon, the winged, rich in mares—may those fires bring us across to fulfillments,' / with this he addresses the wheel.

sanskrit_iast: aṅkau nyaṅkāv abhito rathaṃ ye dhvāntā vātā agram abhi ye saṃpatanti | dūrehetiḥ patatrī vājinīvāṃs te no 'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pārayantu | iti cakram abhimantrayate |
meaning: अङ्कौ न्यङ्काव् अभितो रथं ये ध्वान्ता वाता अग्रम् अभि ये संपतन्ति । दूरेहेतिः पतत्री वाजिनीवांस् ते नो ऽग्नयः पप्रयः पारयन्तु । इति चक्रम् अभिमन्त्रयते ।

sanskrit_iast: sukiṃśukaṃ śalmaliṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ sudhuraṃ sucakram | āroha sūrye amṛtasya panthāṃs tena yāhi gṛhān svasti | ityāropayet |
meaning: सुकिंशुकं शल्मलिं विश्वरूपं हिरण्यवर्णं सुधुरं सुचक्रम् । आरोह सूर्ये अमृतस्य पन्थांस् तेन याहि गृहान् स्वस्ति । इत्यारोपयेत् ।
text_mt: 'Mount the śalmali [wood chariot], well-flowered with kiṃśuka, possessing all forms, golden-hued, well-poised, with good wheels, / [onto] the paths of immortality, O Sūryā; go thereby safely to the homes,' / with this he should make her mount.

sanskrit_iast: upa māyantu devatā upa brahma suvīryam | upa kṣatraṃ ca yadbalamupa māmaitu yadbalam | iti prayāsyan japati |
meaning: उप मायन्तु देवता उप ब्रह्म सुवीर्यम् । उप क्षत्रं च यद्बलमुप मामैतु यद्बलम् । इति प्रयास्यन् जपति ।
text_mt: 'May the deities come to me; may the holy power, excellent virility, / may the ruling power and whatever is strength—may whatever is strength come to me,' / reciting this he mutters as he is about to set out.

sanskrit_iast: anu māyantu devatā anu brahma suvīryam | anu kṣatraṃ ca yad yaśamanu māmaitu yadyaśam | iti prāñcaṃ prayāpya pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya yathārthalakṣaṇyavṛkṣaṃ caityaṃ vopatiṣṭheta |
meaning: अनु मायन्तु देवता अनु ब्रह्म सुवीर्यम् । अनु क्षत्रं च यद् यशमनु मामैतु यद्यशम् । इति प्राञ्चं प्रयाप्य प्रदक्षिणमावृत्य यथार्थलक्षण्यवृक्षं चैत्यं वोपतिष्ठेत ।
text_mt: 'May the deities follow me; may the holy power, excellent virility, / may the ruling power and whatever is fame—may whatever is fame follow me,' / having thus set out toward the east and turned clockwise, he should approach a tree of auspicious characteristics or a sanctuary according to need.

sanskrit_iast: namo rudrāyaikavṛkṣasada ityekavṛkṣe japati | ye vṛkṣeṣu śaṣpiñjarā iti ca |
meaning: नमो रुद्रायैकवृक्षसद इत्येकवृक्षे जपति । ये वृक्षेषु शष्पिञ्जरा इति च ।
text_mt: 'Homage to Rudra who sits in a single tree,' he mutters at a single tree, / and 'Those who are reddish-yellow among the trees...'

sanskrit_iast: namo rudrāya catuṣpathasada iti catuṣpathe | ye pathāṃ pathirakṣaya iti ca |
meaning: नमो रुद्राय चतुष्पथसद इति चतुष्पथे । ये पथां पथिरक्षय इति च ।
text_mt: 'Homage to Rudra who sits at the crossroads,' at a crossroads, / and 'Those who are the guardians of paths upon the paths...'

sanskrit_iast: namo rudrāya śmaśānasada iti śmaśāne | ye bhūtānām adhipataya iti ca |
meaning: नमो रुद्राय श्मशानसद इति श्मशाने । ये भूतानाम् अधिपतय इति च ।
text_mt: 'Homage to Rudra who sits at the cremation ground,' at a cremation ground, / and 'Those who are the lords of beings...'

sanskrit_iast: namo rudrāya pātrasada iti piban | ye anneṣu vividhyantīti ca |
meaning: नमो रुद्राय पात्रसद इति पिबन् । ये अन्नेषु विविध्यन्तीति च ।
text_mt: 'Homage to Rudra who sits in a vessel,' when drinking, / and 'Those who pierce in foods...'

sanskrit_iast: ye tīrthānīti tīrthe |
meaning: ये तीर्थानीति तीर्थे ।

sanskrit_iast: yatrāpas taritavyā āsīd ati samudrāya vayunāya sindhūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | nadīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ pitve juhutā viśvakarmaṇe | viśvahādābhyaṃ haviḥ | ity apsūdakāñjalīr juhuyāt |
meaning: यत्रापस् तरितव्या आसीद् अति समुद्राय वयुनाय सिन्धूनां पतये नमः । नदीनां सर्वासां पित्वे जुहुता विश्वकर्मणे । विश्वहादाभ्यं हविः । इत्य् अप्सूदकाञ्जलीर् जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: Where waters are to be crossed: / 'Hail to the ocean, to the guide, homage to the lord of rivers. / Offer to Viśvakarman, for the drink of all rivers, / an oblation that can never be harmed,' / with this he should offer handfuls of water into the waters.

sanskrit_iast: yāvatāṃ sakhāyānaṃ svastimicchet tāvata udakāñjalīr juhuyāt amṛtam āsye juhomyāyuḥ prāṇe pratidadhāmi amṛtaṃ brahmaṇā saha mṛtyuṃ tarema | prāsahād itīṣṭir asyaditir eva mṛtyuṃdhayamiti trir ācāmet |
meaning: यावतां सखायानं स्वस्तिमिच्छेत् तावत उदकाञ्जलीर् जुहुयात् अमृतम् आस्ये जुहोम्यायुः प्राणे प्रतिदधामि अमृतं ब्रह्मणा सह मृत्युं तरेम । प्रासहाद् इतीष्टिर् अस्यदितिर् एव मृत्युंधयमिति त्रिर् आचामेत् ।
text_mt: For as many companions as he wishes welfare, he should offer that many folded handfuls of water with: 'I offer immortality into my mouth, I place life in my breath, along with Brahman may we cross beyond death.' / With 'By overpowering...' he should sip water three times, [saying]: 'An offering she is, Aditi indeed, drinking death.'

sanskrit_iast: dviḥ parimṛjet |
meaning: द्विः परिमृजेत् ।

sanskrit_iast: yadyakṣā śamyāṇir vā riṣyeta tatraivāgnim upasamādhāyāgneyena sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiś cājyasya pustāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ |
meaning: यद्यक्षा शम्याणिर् वा रिष्येत तत्रैवाग्निम् उपसमाधायाग्नेयेन स्थालीपाकेनेष्ट्वा जयप्रभृतिभिश् चाज्यस्य पुस्तात् स्विष्टकृतः ।
text_mt: If the axle, the yoke-pin, or the linchpin should be damaged, having set up the fire right there, having sacrificed with a pot-cooked offering to Agni and with [the offerings] beginning with the Jaya [formulas] of clarified butter prior to the Sviṣṭakṛt,

sanskrit_iast: aparasyāhnaḥ saṃdhikāle gṛhān prapādayet |
meaning: अपरस्याह्नः संधिकाले गृहान् प्रपादयेत् ।
text_mt: at the twilight of the next day, he should make [her] enter the house.

sanskrit_iast: rathādyaupāsanāt saṃtatāmulaparājīṃ stṛṇāti |
meaning: रथाद्यौपासनात् संततामुलपराजीं स्तृणाति ।
text_mt: From the chariot to the domestic fire, he spreads a continuous line of reed grass.

sanskrit_iast: tayābhyupaiti |
meaning: तयाभ्युपैति ।

sanskrit_iast: gṛhānahaṃ sumanasaḥ prapadye 'vīraghnī vīravataḥ suśevā | irāṃ vahantī ghṛtam ukṣamāṇāṃs teṣv ahaṃ sumanāḥ saṃviśāmi | ity abhyāhitāgniṃ sodakaṃ sauṣadhamāvasathaṃ prapadye | revatyā rohiṇyā yadvā puṇyoktam |
meaning: गृहानहं सुमनसः प्रपद्ये ऽवीरघ्नी वीरवतः सुशेवा । इरां वहन्ती घृतम् उक्षमाणांस् तेष्व् अहं सुमनाः संविशामि । इत्य् अभ्याहिताग्निं सोदकं सौषधमावसथं प्रपद्ये । रेवत्या रोहिण्या यद्वा पुण्योक्तम् ।
text_mt: 'I enter the house, joyful, not harming the heroes, rich in heroes, very kind; / bringing nourishment, sprinkling clarified butter, among them I, joyful, settle down'— / with this formula [he makes her enter] the dwelling, which has the fire set up, water, and herbs, / under [the asterism] Revatī or Rohiṇī, or whatever is declared auspicious.

sanskrit_iast: ānaḍuhe carmaṇyupaviśya |
meaning: आनडुहे चर्मण्युपविश्य ।
text_mt: Having seated [her] on an ox-hide,

sanskrit_iast: athāsyā brahmacāriṇaṃ jīvapitṛkaṃ jīvamātṛkam utsaṅgamupaveśayet |
meaning: अथास्या ब्रह्मचारिणं जीवपितृकं जीवमातृकम् उत्सङ्गमुपवेशयेत् ।
text_mt: he should then place in her lap a Vedic student whose father is living and whose mother is living.

sanskrit_iast: phalānāmañjaliṃ pūrayet tilataṇḍulānāṃ vā |
meaning: फलानामञ्जलिं पूरयेत् तिलतण्डुलानां वा ।
text_mt: He should fill [his] folded hands with fruits or with sesame and rice grains.

sanskrit_iast: acyutā dhruvā dhruvapatnī dhruvaṃ paśyema viśvata iti dhruvaṃ jīvantīṃ saptarṣīn arundhatīmiti darśayitvā prājāpatyena sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiś cājyasya purastāt sviṣṭakṛta ājyaśeṣe dadhyāsicya dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam iti dadhnaḥ pumāṃstriḥ prāśnāti |
meaning: अच्युता ध्रुवा ध्रुवपत्नी ध्रुवं पश्येम विश्वत इति ध्रुवं जीवन्तीं सप्तर्षीन् अरुन्धतीमिति दर्शयित्वा प्राजापत्येन स्थालीपाकेनेष्ट्वा जयप्रभृतिभिश् चाज्यस्य पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृत आज्यशेषे दध्यासिच्य दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषम् इति दध्नः पुमांस्त्रिः प्राश्नाति ।
text_mt: Having shown [her] the pole star, the living [herb], the Seven Seers, and Arundhatī with: 'Unfallen, firm, wife of the firm one, may we see the firm one from all sides,' having sacrificed with a pot-cooked offering to Prajāpati and with [the offerings] beginning with the Jaya [formulas] of clarified butter prior to the Sviṣṭakṛt, having poured curds into the remainder of the clarified butter, the man eats the curds three times with: 'I have praised Dadhikrāvan...'

sanskrit_iast: cakram ivānaḍuhaḥ padaṃ māmevānvetu te manaḥ | māṃ ca paśyasi sūryaṃ ca mā cānyeṣu manaskṛthāḥ | cākravākaṃ saṃvasanaṃ tan nau saṃvananaṃ kṛtam | ityavaśiṣṭaṃ jāyāyai prayacchati |
meaning: चक्रम् इवानडुहः पदं मामेवान्वेतु ते मनः । मां च पश्यसि सूर्यं च मा चान्येषु मनस्कृथाः । चाक्रवाकं संवसनं तन् नौ संवननं कृतम् । इत्यवशिष्टं जायायै प्रयच्छति ।
text_mt: 'As the ox's foot [follows] the wheel, so let your mind follow me; / look at me and look at the sun, and do not set your mind on others; / the dwelling together of the cakravāka birds, that attraction has been made for us two'— / with this formula he gives the remainder to his wife.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ sā prāśnāti |
meaning: तूष्णीं सा प्राश्नाति ।

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ mudā tau brahmacaryaṃ carataḥ | dvādaśarātraṃ trirātram ekarātraṃ vā |
meaning: संवत्सरं मुदा तौ ब्रह्मचर्यं चरतः । द्वादशरात्रं त्रिरात्रम् एकरात्रं वा ।
text_mt: The two observe chastity with joy for a year, / or for twelve nights, or three nights, or one night.

sanskrit_iast: evameva caturthyāṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭābhiḥ sthālīpākasya hutvā jayaprabhṛtibhiścājyasya purastātsviṣṭakṛtaḥ |
meaning: एवमेव चतुर्थ्यां कृत्वा हिरण्यगर्भ इत्यष्टाभिः स्थालीपाकस्य हुत्वा जयप्रभृतिभिश्चाज्यस्य पुरस्तात्स्विष्टकृतः ।
text_mt: Having done the same on the fourth [night], having offered the pot-cooked offering with the eight [verses beginning with] 'The Golden Embryo...' and [the offerings] beginning with the Jaya [formulas] of clarified butter prior to the Sviṣṭakṛt,

sanskrit_iast: athāsyāḥ savye 'ṃse pūṣā te granthiṃ grathnātv iti vāsaso granthiṃ kriyamāṇam anumantrayate |
meaning: अथास्याः सव्ये ऽंसे पूषा ते ग्रन्थिं ग्रथ्नात्व् इति वाससो ग्रन्थिं क्रियमाणम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
text_mt: he then blesses the knot of her garment being tied on her left shoulder with: 'May Pūṣan tie your knot.'

sanskrit_iast: catasro 'vidhavāḥ kurvanti | tābhyo hiraṇyaṃ dadāti |
meaning: चतस्रो ऽविधवाः कुर्वन्ति । ताभ्यो हिरण्यं ददाति ।
text_mt: Four non-widows make [it]; / he gives gold to them.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ na pravaset | dvādaśarātraṃ trirātram ekarātraṃ vā |
meaning: संवत्सरं न प्रवसेत् । द्वादशरात्रं त्रिरात्रम् एकरात्रं वा ।
text_mt:
He should not go away on a journey for a year, / or for twelve nights, or three nights, or one night.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 16
The two copulate. / 'I saw you with my mind, discerning, born from heat, overcome by heat; / granting here offspring, granting here wealth, be fruitful with offspring, you who desire a son.' / 'I saw you with my mind, brooding, longing in your own body at the proper season; / may the young woman come up high to me; be fruitful with offspring, you who desire a son.' / 'O Prajāpati, enjoy my body; Tvaṣṭṛ, with heroes, by force I am Indra; / let the plants wrap themselves around with Indra, with the gods; may we two be the parents of many male children.' / 'I produced offspring on earth, I placed the embryo in the plants; / I am within all beings; I carry sons for offspring'— / thus the two recite alternating, the woman beginning.

sanskrit_iast: tau saṃnipātayataḥ | apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso 'bhibhūtam | iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ prajāyasva prajayā putrakāma | apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanūm ṛtviye nādhamānām | upa mām uccā yuvatir babhūyāt prajāyasva prajayā putrakāme | prajāpate tanvaṃ me juṣasva tvaṣṭā vīraiḥ sahasāham indraḥ | indreṇa devairvīrudhaḥ saṃvyayantāṃ bahūnāṃ puṃsāṃ pitarau syāva | ahaṃ prajā ajanayaṃ pṛthivyām ahaṃ garbham adadhāmoṣadhīṣu | ahaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantar ahaṃ prajābhyo bibharṣi putrān | iti stryādivyatyāsaṃ japataḥ |
meaning: तौ संनिपातयतः । अपश्यं त्वा मनसा चेकितानं तपसो जातं तपसो ऽभिभूतम् । इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणः प्रजायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकाम । अपश्यं त्वा मनसा दीध्यानां स्वायां तनूम् ऋत्विये नाधमानाम् । उप माम् उच्चा युवतिर् बभूयात् प्रजायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकामे । प्रजापते तन्वं मे जुषस्व त्वष्टा वीरैः सहसाहम् इन्द्रः । इन्द्रेण देवैर्वीरुधः संव्ययन्तां बहूनां पुंसां पितरौ स्याव । अहं प्रजा अजनयं पृथिव्याम् अहं गर्भम् अदधामोषधीषु । अहं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तर् अहं प्रजाभ्यो बिभर्षि पुत्रान् । इति स्त्र्यादिव्यत्यासं जपतः ।

sanskrit_iast: karad iti bhasadabhimṛśet |
meaning: करद् इति भसदभिमृशेत् ।
text_mt: With 'karat' he should touch her pudenda.

sanskrit_iast: janad ity uparijananam |
meaning: जनद् इत्य् उपरिजननम् ।
text_mt: With 'janat', the upper genital area.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhad iti jātaḥ pratiṣṭhitam |
meaning: बृहद् इति जातः प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
text_mt: With 'bṛhat', the established child.

sanskrit_iast: athāsyāstṛtīye garbhamāse puṃsā nakṣatreṇa yad ahaścandramā na dṛśyeta tadahar vopoṣyāplāvyāhataṃ vāsa ācchādya nyagrodhāvarohaśuṅgānyudapeṣaṃ piṣṭvā dakṣiṇāsminnāsikāchidra āsiñcet hiraṇyagarbhaḥ | adbhyaḥ saṃbhṛta ityetābhyām |
meaning: अथास्यास्तृतीये गर्भमासे पुंसा नक्षत्रेण यद् अहश्चन्द्रमा न दृश्येत तदहर् वोपोष्याप्लाव्याहतं वास आच्छाद्य न्यग्रोधावरोहशुङ्गान्युदपेषं पिष्ट्वा दक्षिणास्मिन्नासिकाछिद्र आसिञ्चेत् हिरण्यगर्भः । अद्भ्यः संभृत इत्येताभ्याम् ।
text_mt: Then, in the third month of her pregnancy, under a male asterism, on whatever day the moon is not visible, having fasted on that day, having bathed her and dressed her in an unwashed garment, having ground sprout-tips of banyan aerial roots with water, he should pour [it] into her right nostril with these two [verses]: 'The Golden Embryo...' [and] 'Brought together from the waters...'.

sanskrit_iast: athāsyā dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣim abhimṛśet pumān agniḥ pumānindraḥ pumāndevo bṛhaspatiḥ | pumānagniśca vāyuśca pumāngarbhas tavodare | pumāṃsau mitrāvaruṇau pumāṃsāv aśvināv ubhau | pumāṃsaṃ garbhaṃ jāyasva tvaṃ pumān anujāyatām | ityetābhyām |
meaning: अथास्या दक्षिणं कुक्षिम् अभिमृशेत् पुमान् अग्निः पुमानिन्द्रः पुमान्देवो बृहस्पतिः । पुमानग्निश्च वायुश्च पुमान्गर्भस् तवोदरे । पुमांसौ मित्रावरुणौ पुमांसाव् अश्विनाव् उभौ । पुमांसं गर्भं जायस्व त्वं पुमान् अनुजायताम् । इत्येताभ्याम् ।
text_mt: Then he should touch her right belly with these two [verses]: 'Agni is male, Indra is male, the god Bṛhaspati is male; / Agni is male and Vāyu is male; a male is the embryo in your womb. / Both Mitra and Varuṇa are male, both the Aśvins are male; / be born as a male embryo, let a male be born after you.'

sanskrit_iast: athāsyāḥ pañcame ṣaṣṭhe saptame vā garbhamāse maṅgalyaiḥ snāpayitvā prājāpatyena sthālīpākeneṣṭvā jayaprabhṛtibhiścājyasya purastātsviṣṭakṛtaḥ | paścādagnerdarbheṣv āsīnāyāḥ sarvān keśān vipramucya tvamaryamā bhavasi yatkanīnāṃ devaḥ svadhāvo guhyaṃ bibharṣi | añjanti vipraṃ sukṛtaṃ na gobhir yad dampatī sumanasā kṛṇoṣi | iti navanītena pāṇī pralipya sarvān keśān saṃprayauti |
meaning: अथास्याः पञ्चमे षष्ठे सप्तमे वा गर्भमासे मङ्गल्यैः स्नापयित्वा प्राजापत्येन स्थालीपाकेनेष्ट्वा जयप्रभृतिभिश्चाज्यस्य पुरस्तात्स्विष्टकृतः । पश्चादग्नेर्दर्भेष्व् आसीनायाः सर्वान् केशान् विप्रमुच्य त्वमर्यमा भवसि यत्कनीनां देवः स्वधावो गुह्यं बिभर्षि । अञ्जन्ति विप्रं सुकृतं न गोभिर् यद् दम्पती सुमनसा कृणोषि । इति नवनीतेन पाणी प्रलिप्य सर्वान् केशान् संप्रयौति ।
text_mt: Then, in the fifth, sixth, or seventh month of her pregnancy, having bathed her with auspicious [substances], having sacrificed with a pot-cooked offering to Prajāpati and with [the offerings] beginning with the Jaya [formulas] of clarified butter prior to the Sviṣṭakṛt, / when she is seated on darbha grass to the west of the fire, having loosened all her hair, with: 'You are Aryaman when of the maidens... O self-willed god, you bear the secret [name]; / they anoint the wise, well-acting one as if with milk, when you make the husband and wife like-minded'— / having smeared his hands with fresh butter, he mixes all her hair together.

sanskrit_iast: indrāṇī cakre kaṅkataṃ sa sīmantaṃ visarpatu iti kaṅkataṃ gṛhṇāti |
meaning: इन्द्राणी चक्रे कङ्कतं स सीमन्तं विसर्पतु इति कङ्कतं गृह्णाति ।
text_mt: With: 'Indrāṇī made a comb; let it glide through the parting of the hair,' he takes a comb.

sanskrit_iast: punaḥ patnīmagniriti keśaprasādhanaṃ kuryāt |
meaning: पुनः पत्नीमग्निरिति केशप्रसाधनं कुर्यात् ।
text_mt: With: 'Agni again [gave] the wife...' he should arrange her hair.

sanskrit_iast: śalalyā śamīśākhayā sapalāśayā | antarvatī pumāṃsaṃ dīrghaṃ jīvantaṃ śatāyuṣam | dīrghāyur asyā yaḥ patir jīvātu śaradaḥ śatam | iti triśvetayā sīmantaṃ karoti |
meaning: शलल्या शमीशाखया सपलाशया । अन्तर्वती पुमांसं दीर्घं जीवन्तं शतायुषम् । दीर्घायुर् अस्या यः पतिर् जीवातु शरदः शतम् । इति त्रिश्वेतया सीमन्तं करोति ।
text_mt: With a porcupine quill, [and] with a leafy branch of śamī / [and the verse]: 'Pregnant with a male, long-living, living a hundred years; / long-lived is her husband, let him live a hundred autumns'— / with a three-white-spotted [quill] he makes the parting of the hair.

sanskrit_iast: athāsyāḥ patir dvedhā keśān badhnāti nīlalohitena sūtreṇa jīvorṇayā vā |
meaning: अथास्याः पतिर् द्वेधा केशान् बध्नाति नीललोहितेन सूत्रेण जीवोर्णया वा ।
text_mt:
Then her husband ties her hair in two parts with a blue-and-red thread or with living wool.

Vārāhagṛhyasūtra, 17
Now we shall explain the offering to All the Gods.

sanskrit_iast: atha vaiśvadevaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
meaning: अथ वैश्वदेवं व्याख्यास्यामः ।

sanskrit_iast: tatra sāyaṃprātaḥprabhṛtīnām agnihotravat parisamuhya paristīrya paryukṣya sāyaṃ prātaḥ syādityeke |
meaning: तत्र सायंप्रातःप्रभृतीनाम् अग्निहोत्रवत् परिसमुह्य परिस्तीर्य पर्युक्ष्य सायं प्रातः स्यादित्येके ।
text_mt: There, some say that for those [rites] beginning with the evening and morning [offerings], having swept around, strewn [grass] around, and sprinkled water around, it should be like the Agnihotra in the evening and in the morning.

sanskrit_iast: haviṣyasya vā siddhasya vaiśvadevaḥ |
meaning: हविष्यस्य वा सिद्धस्य वैश्वदेवः ।
text_mt: Or the offering to All the Gods is of sacrificial food that is prepared.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye somāya prajāpataye dhanvantaraye vāstoṣpataye viśvebhyo devebhyo 'gnaye sviṣṭakṛte ca juhuyāt |
meaning: अग्नये सोमाय प्रजापतये धन्वन्तरये वास्तोष्पतये विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो ऽग्नये स्विष्टकृते च जुहुयात् ।
text_mt: He should sacrifice to Agni, to Soma, to Prajāpati, to Dhanvantari, to Vāstoṣpati, to All the Gods, and to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: avaśiṣṭasya baliṃ haret |
meaning: अवशिष्टस्य बलिं हरेत् ।
text_mt: Of the remainder, he should present the bali offering.

sanskrit_iast: dadhimadhumiśrasyāgnaye purastāt yamāya dakṣiṇataḥ somāya paścāt varuṇāyottarataḥ madhye varuṇāryamabhyāṃ brahmaṇe ca | agnaye pṛthivyai vāyave 'ntarikṣāya sūryāya dive candramase nakṣatrebhya iti |
meaning: दधिमधुमिश्रस्याग्नये पुरस्तात् यमाय दक्षिणतः सोमाय पश्चात् वरुणायोत्तरतः मध्ये वरुणार्यमभ्यां ब्रह्मणे च । अग्नये पृथिव्यै वायवे ऽन्तरिक्षाय सूर्याय दिवे चन्द्रमसे नक्षत्रेभ्य इति ।
text_mt: Of that mixed with curds and honey, to Agni in the east, to Yama in the south, to Soma in the west, to Varuṇa in the north, in the middle to Varuṇa and Aryaman, and to Brahman; / with: 'To Agni, to the Earth, to Vāyu, to the Atmosphere, to the Sun, to the Sky, to the Moon, to the Asterisms.'

sanskrit_iast: adbhyaḥ kumbhadeśe |
meaning: अद्भ्यः कुम्भदेशे ।

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhivanaspatibhyo madhyadeśe |
meaning: ओषधिवनस्पतिभ्यो मध्यदेशे ।
text_mt: To the Plants and Trees, in the middle place.

sanskrit_iast: kāmāya | gṛhapataya iti śayyādeśe |
meaning: कामाय । गृहपतय इति शय्यादेशे ।
text_mt: To Desire [and] to the Master of the House, at the place of the bed.

sanskrit_iast: śriyai ca |
meaning: श्रियै च ।

sanskrit_iast: rakṣojanebhyo 'ntaḥ śaraṇe |
meaning: रक्षोजनेभ्यो ऽन्तः शरणे ।
text_mt: To the Rakṣas-folk, inside the house.

sanskrit_iast: ākāśāyeti sthalikāṇḍābhyām |
meaning: आकाशायेति स्थलिकाण्डाभ्याम् ।
text_mt: With 'To Space', by means of the mortar and pestle.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ niṣkramyopari śaraṇe |
meaning: तूष्णीं निष्क्रम्योपरि शरणे ।
text_mt: Having stepped out silently, above the house.

sanskrit_iast: kavyaṃ prācyām |
meaning: कव्यं प्राच्याम् ।

sanskrit_iast: pitṛbhyaḥ svadhetyanuṣajet |
meaning: पितृभ्यः स्वधेत्यनुषजेत् ।
text_mt: He should attach: 'To the ancestors, svadhā!'

sanskrit_iast: nama ityante ca |
meaning: नम इत्यन्ते च ।

sanskrit_iast: ye brāhmaṇāḥ prācyāṃ diśyarhantu | ye devā yāni bhūtāni prapadye tāni me svastyayanaṃ kurvantviti | dakṣiṇasyām | pratīcyām | uttarasyām | ūrdhvāyām | ye brāhmaṇā iti sarvatrānuṣajet |
meaning: ये ब्राह्मणाः प्राच्यां दिश्यर्हन्तु । ये देवा यानि भूतानि प्रपद्ये तानि मे स्वस्त्ययनं कुर्वन्त्विति । दक्षिणस्याम् । प्रतीच्याम् । उत्तरस्याम् । ऊर्ध्वायाम् । ये ब्राह्मणा इति सर्वत्रानुषजेत् ।
text_mt: 'Whatever brāhmaṇas are in the eastern quarter, let them be worthy; / whatever gods, whatever beings [there are], I take refuge in them, let them make safety for me'— / in the south, / in the west, / in the north, / in the upper [direction]; / he should attach 'Whatever brāhmaṇas...' everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: snehavad amāṃsam annaṃ bhojayitvā viduṣo brāhmaṇān arthasiddhiṃ vācayet |
meaning: स्नेहवद् अमांसम् अन्नं भोजयित्वा विदुषो ब्राह्मणान् अर्थसिद्धिं वाचयेत् ।
text_mt: Having fed learned Brahmins rich, meatless food, he should make [them] utter [a blessing for] the attainment of [his] goals.

sanskrit_iast: baliharaṇasyānte yāmāśiṣam icchet tām āśāsīta |
meaning: बलिहरणस्यान्ते यामाशिषम् इच्छेत् ताम् आशासीत ।
text_mt: At the conclusion of the presentation of the bali offering, whatever blessing he desires, that he should pray for.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhapatiḥ oṃ akṣayam annam astv ity āha |
meaning: गृहपतिः ओं अक्षयम् अन्नम् अस्त्व् इत्य् आह ।
text_mt: The householder says, "Om! May the food be inexhaustible!"

sanskrit_iast: bhikṣāṃ pradāya sāyaṃ bhojanameva prātar āśet |
meaning: भिक्षां प्रदाय सायं भोजनमेव प्रातर् आशेत् ।
text_mt: Having given alms, he should eat in the morning precisely the evening meal.

sanskrit_iast: viproṣya gṛhānupatiṣṭhet |
meaning: विप्रोष्य गृहानुपतिष्ठेत् ।
text_mt: Having returned from a journey, he should pay homage to the house.
